title: Senior Business Funding Strategist — 0% APR Credit & Revenue-Based Funding
description:
COMPANY: JJT Consulting Group LLC

LOCATION: Remote — Philippines

SCHEDULE: Full-time availability during U.S. Eastern business hours

COMPENSATION: Competitive base pay + commission incentives tied to successful funding outcomes



ABOUT THE ROLE



JJT Consulting Group helps U.S. business owners pursue capital through business credit and revenue-based funding strategies.



We’re looking for an experienced Funding Strategist who can independently assess a client’s financial profile, recommend suitable funding options, and manage execution from initial review through approval and funding.



You should understand how to evaluate lender fit, sequence applications responsibly, protect client eligibility, explain costs and risks clearly, and communicate confidently with business owners.



This role requires sound judgment, strong follow-through, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple client files without constant supervision.



RESPONSIBILITIES



• Review personal and business credit reports, business information, bank statements, revenue, cash flow, and existing obligations.

• Assess funding readiness and identify issues that could affect approvals, pricing, available limits, or repayment capacity.

• Develop personalized funding strategies based on each client’s goals, profile, timing, and risk factors.

• Recommend suitable lenders and products, including 0% introductory APR business credit cards and revenue-based funding, when appropriate.

• Determine application order, timing, preparation steps, and required documentation.

• Evaluate whether revolving credit, revenue-based financing, or a combination fits the client’s needs.

• Clearly explain promotional periods, fees, repayment structures, obligations, risks, and next steps.

• Manage applications through submission, lender follow-up, approval, closing, and funding.

• Verify documents and resolve missing information or inconsistencies before submission.

• Communicate proactively with clients and lenders through calls, text messages, and
.

• Maintain accurate CRM records, lender notes, application statuses, funding totals, and next actions.

• Follow company SOPs and communication deadlines, escalating issues when needed.

• Recommend improvements to application quality, client experience, and funding execution.

• Protect client confidentiality and handle financial information responsibly.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



• Hands-on experience in U.S. business funding, business credit, commercial lending, or a closely related field.

• Familiarity with both 0% introductory APR business credit card strategies and revenue-based funding.

• Strong understanding of credit utilization, payment history, inquiries, credit age, personal guarantees, business structure, and lender eligibility.

• Experience analyzing bank statements, revenue trends, cash flow, deposits, balances, negative days, and existing payment obligations.

• Ability to develop and explain a complete funding strategy independently.

• Sound judgment about lender fit, application timing, client readiness, and when to postpone or decline an application.

• Excellent spoken and written English.

• Strong organization, attention to detail, and ownership of deadlines.

• Confidence managing client calls and multiple applications at different stages.

• Reliable internet, a quiet professional workspace, and consistent availability during U.S. Eastern business hours.

• Ability to communicate funding terms accurately without making guarantees about approval, limits, rates, or timing.



Experience with GoHighLevel, lender portals, CRM systems, funding trackers, and document-management workflows is strongly preferred.



COMPENSATION & OPPORTUNITY



• Competitive base pay reflecting your experience and demonstrated ability.

• Commission incentives on successfully funded deals, allowing you to increase your earnings through strong execution and results.

• Clear performance expectations and commission terms established in writing before you start.

• Ownership of client funding strategies from assessment through funding completion.

• The opportunity to contribute your lender knowledge and improve our funding systems.

• Room to grow into greater responsibility as you demonstrate consistent performance.



Commission eligibility, payment timing, treatment of cancellations or chargebacks, and the definition of a successfully funded deal will be explained before employment begins.



We want a strategist who can deliver—and we want your compensation to reflect the value you bring.



HOW WE MEASURE SUCCESS



• Accurate funding assessments and well-reasoned strategies.

• Appropriate lender and product recommendations.

• Complete, accurate applications and timely submissions.

• Proactive client and lender communication.

• Approval and funding outcomes relative to client eligibility, without sacrificing suitability or compliance.

• Accurate CRM records and reliable pipeline management.

• Consistent adherence to company processes, deadlines, and confidentiality requirements.

• Client trust, clarity, and overall experience.

• Responsible use of client information and accurate representation of funding terms.



HOW TO APPLY



Apply through OnlineJobs.ph with ALL of the following:



1. Your updated résumé.

2. A 2–3 minute Loom video introducing yourself and explaining your relevant funding experience.

3. A brief, anonymized funding strategy example covering the client’s general profile, funding objective, lenders or products considered, recommended application sequence, reasoning, and final outcome if available.

4. A list of funding products, lenders, lender portals, and CRM systems you have worked with.

5. Your availability in U.S. Eastern Time.

6. Your expected base compensation.

7. Measurable results, if available, such as approval rates, total funding facilitated, average client funding, or number of applications managed.



Remove all client-identifying and confidential information from your examples. Do not include account numbers, Social Security numbers, full credit reports, bank statements, login credentials, or other sensitive data.



APPLICATION SUBJECT: Funding Strategist — Ready to Own Results



Incomplete applications will not be considered. Your application must include the Loom video, strategy example, relevant platform experience, availability, and compensation expectations.

title: VICE PRESIDENT OF LOGISTICS
description:
VICE PRESIDENT OF LOGISTICS & OPERATIONS

SPRINTER | REMOTE | HOURLY FREELANCE / CONTRACT

Position: Vice President of Logistics & Operations / Head of Logistics

Company: SPRINTER | Concord Pacific Corp.

Location: 100% remote; qualified U.S. and international applicants welcome

Compensation: Hourly rate, based on experience | Long-term opportunity

Website: 

ABOUT SPRINTER

SPRINTER is developing a technology-enabled network for same-day and next-day city-to-city package delivery in the

United States. Its approach combines vetted drivers already traveling toward a package destination, dedicated delivery

drivers, planned retail drop-off and pickup locations, and secure reusable Smart Shipping Boxes.

Our initial technology platform has been developed. We are seeking an accomplished logistics leader to help design,

launch and scale the operational network, starting with selected California corridors.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We need an experienced, hands-on logistics executive - not simply an advisor. You will work directly with the

Founder & CEO to translate a high-potential logistics concept into reliable daily operations, measurable service quality

and a scalable nationwide model.

STRONGLY PREFERRED: UPS, FEDEX OR DHL EXPERIENCE

Strong preference will be given to candidates who previously held management, senior management or

executive positions with UPS, FedEx, DHL, or another major international parcel-delivery or logistics

organization. We especially value experience with large delivery networks, dispatch, fleet and driver operations,

distribution centers, route planning, operational controls and regional or national expansion. Former UPS, FedEx and

DHL operations leaders are strongly encouraged to apply.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Logistics network design: Develop California launch corridors, operational models, service areas, routing, capacity

plans and a roadmap for expansion across the United States.

• Same-day and next-day delivery: Establish SOPs covering package acceptance, pickup, dispatch, transportation,

tracking, delivery confirmation, exceptions and customer handoffs.

• Cutoff-time planning: Build operations around proposed 11:00 AM same-day and 5:00 PM next-day drop-off/pickup

cutoffs, validating feasibility by corridor before launch.

• Driver network: Design recruiting, vetting, onboarding, scheduling, performance management and service standards

for route-match drivers and dedicated SPRINTER drivers.

• Pickup and drop-off partnerships: Develop operating procedures and partner requirements for a planned network of

3,000+ nationwide retail locations; this network is a growth objective, not an existing footprint.

• Transportation economics: Evaluate cost per shipment, driver compensation, route density, vehicle utilization,

delivery time, operating expenses and profitability.

• Technology collaboration: Work with the product and engineering teams on driver-package matching, dispatch

workflows, tracking, proof of delivery, reporting and Smart Box integration.

SPRINTER | CONFIDENTIAL RECRUITMENT DRAFT 1

• Compliance and safety: Coordinate with legal/compliance specialists on transport regulations, insurance, driver

standards, package restrictions, claims and loss prevention.

• Team leadership: Recruit, train and manage dispatch coordinators, regional operations managers and transportation

partners as the business scales.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 7-10+ years of progressively responsible experience in parcel delivery, courier networks, transportation, 3PL,

distribution or logistics operations.

• Demonstrated success launching, building, managing or expanding a delivery operation - preferably at regional or

national scale.

• Strong knowledge of dispatch, route optimization, driver operations, SOPs, cost controls, performance metrics and

service reliability.

• Understanding of U.S. transportation and logistics operations, even if working remotely from outside the United States.

• Excellent English communication, leadership, financial analysis, project management and independent execution

skills.

• Experience with technology-enabled logistics, on-demand delivery, two-sided marketplaces or driver networks is a

plus.

WHO WILL SUCCEED

A strategic but practical operator who can design a network, identify operational risks, build a launch plan, lead

execution, recruit capable people and produce measurable outcomes. We prefer professionals who have built or

launched logistics operations, not only supervised established teams.

WORK ARRANGEMENT & COMPENSATION

This is a fully remote, hourly paid freelance/contract position. Hours and hourly compensation will be agreed based

on experience, availability and responsibilities. The engagement may develop into a longer-term executive leadership

relationship as SPRINTER grows.

HOW TO APPLY ON 

Please review 
 before applying. Generic proposals will not be prioritized. In your application,

include:

• Your logistics background and the operations or delivery networks you have managed or built.

• Major-company experience: Whether you worked for UPS, FedEx, DHL or a comparable company; your job title,

dates, principal responsibilities and measurable accomplishments.

• A brief outline of how you would launch California same-day/next-day service, including Los Angeles-San Francisco

and Los Angeles-San Diego corridors.

• Your experience recruiting and managing drivers, dispatching shipments, developing SOPs and improving

transportation unit economics.

• Your weekly availability, hourly rate and examples of relevant results.

HELP BUILD THE FUTURE OF CITY-TO-CITY DELIVERY

SPRINTER is seeking a logistics leader who can help turn an innovative delivery model into a successful, reliable and

scalable national operation.

Roman Alexander

Founder & CEO

SPRINTER | CONFIDENTIAL RECRUITMENT DRAFT
salary: $1500 per month plus large bonus program

 marketing and SEO

- You open the card, open the profile, press Message, paste the message, send it, and drag the card to Contacted. About one a minute.

- You start with one of our Instagram accounts, about 50 messages a shift. As our accounts age we add more, up to about 100 a shift.

- If Instagram shows "Try again later", "Action blocked" or a code screen, you stop for the day and tell Victor on Slack. That is always the right move, and your pay does not change.

- Before your first shift you do our 30-minute training, which ends in a practice test. Nothing real is sent.



That is the whole job. No selling, no writing, no research, no calls. One fixed 2-hour shift a day, Monday to Saturday, that you pick between 1 pm and 2 am Manila time (our founder is 4 hours behind you and is reachable then). After 30 days we add accounts and hours if you want them.



YOU NEVER

- Change the text, add your own words, or message someone the CRM did not give you.

- Follow, like, comment, or answer a reply. Our founder answers every reply.

- Keep sending after a warning.



YOU ARE

- Careful. You can do the same small task 100 times a day with care. We spot-check sends every day.

- Reliable. Monday to Saturday, for months. You tell us three days in advance if you cannot work.

- Comfortable in English. You read a profile and write to us on Slack in English.

- Set up: a laptop or desktop (not a phone), Chrome, stable internet of at least 10 Mbps.



PAY

$7 USD per 2-hour shift, paid in full even if Instagram stops you early or the list runs out. Monday to Saturday is about $182 a month. Paid every Monday for the week before, by Wise to your bank or GCash. A $25 bonus when you work every shift for an entire month.



You report to Kevin, the founder, on Slack. Either side can end the arrangement with 7 days' notice; the last week is paid on the Monday as usual.



The Instagram accounts are ours, and any block or restriction on them is our responsibility, never yours.



START: the week you pass the training.



HOW TO APPLY

Apply on our form: 



You attach your CV (and past work if you have some) and answer six short questions. About ten minutes. We only read applications sent through that form.



Shortlisted applicants do our 30-minute training with a practice test.

title: Outbound Calling & Email Outreach (Healthcare / Home Care)
description:
Who we are



We are a healthcare and residential services company in Houston, Texas. We operate group homes and a home care agency. Our growth depends on consistent outreach to the people who refer patients to us: hospital discharge planners, case managers, and social workers.



The role



This is a high-volume outbound calling role. The target is 100 dials per day from a list we provide. You will be calling US healthcare professionals, including discharge planners, case managers, social workers, facility staff, and home care prospects. Log every call outcome, book callbacks, and pass warm leads to our US team.



Schedule

Night shift, covering US Central business hours. Confirm exact hours before posting (approx. 9:00 PM to 6:00 AM Philippine time). The schedule is fixed. No rotating shifts.



Pay



	•	Starting pay: $4.50 per hour

	•	Increases to $5.50 per hour after 4 weeks of training

	•	Paid hourly for time worked, with each hour tracked for call activity, duration, and quality

	•	Compensation reflects tracked call quality



How we track work



Every hour you work must show measurable activity. We track call count, call duration, and call quality through our phone monitoring system (Quo). All calls are recorded and reviewed.



What you must have



	•	Prior cold calling experience. This is not an entry-level position. Applicants without experience will not be considered.



	•	Excellent spoken English. You will speak with American healthcare professionals for hours every day. Clear, confident, and easy to understand.



	•	Proven high call volume in a previous role



	•	Stable internet (please state your speed), a noise-cancelling headset, and a quiet, private room



	•	Willingness to work the night shift consistently, long term



Nice to have, not required



	•	Experience calling US healthcare, home health, or residential care



Training



	•	Paid training first 4 weeks

	•	Call outs are not permitted during training weeks. Anyone who makes a call out during training will be terminated.

	•	Starting pay applies during training, with the increase after 4 weeks



Equipment and connectivity



You are responsible for your own equipment and internet connection. Time lost to equipment or Wi-Fi problems is not paid. 







	•	Live interview on Zoom. Open interview date: Tuesday, October 13

	•	Candidates must answer on their own. Using AI tools to answer interview questions will disqualify you.

	•	Recording and monitoring consent is required before start



How to apply



Start your application with the word HOUSTON so we know you read this posting fully. Applications without it will not be reviewed. Please send:



	•	Your resume

	•	A 60-second voice recording (Vocaroo link is fine) with your name, your cold calling background, and the most calls you have made in one day

	•	One sentence on why night shift works for you



We reply to every serious applicant. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a live Zoom interview.

title: Ad Researcher
description:
We’re looking for an ad researcher with a strong eye for direct response ads.



We run multiple brands and need someone to consistently find strong creative ideas for each one.



You’ll have access to BrandSearch & GetHookd, with thousands of ads to research**. It’s down to you to figure out which ads look promising, what makes them effective and which ideas would work well for our brands.



### What you’ll do



- Research ads from direct competitors and similar brands.

- Look across different verticals for ideas we could adapt.

- Identify strong hooks, angles, offers, demonstrations and formats.

- Save the best examples to our swipe file, organised by brand.

- Add a short explanation of why each ad is worth testing and how we could adapt it.

- Bring fresh ideas to our creative team every week.



We need someone who can make good decisions independently. Saving hundreds of random ads isn’t useful. Picking out the right ones and explaining why is.



### Who we’re looking for



- You have a good eye for ads and understand what makes people stop, watch and buy.

- You understand direct response advertising and proven creative patterns.

- You can spot ideas that would transfer well between products and industries.

- You can explain your thinking clearly.

- You’re organised and comfortable researching across multiple brands.

- You understand that an ad’s appearance or time running doesn’t automatically prove it’s profitable.



### How to apply



Send a short introduction, your relevant experience and **three ecommerce ads you think are strong**:



1. One video ad.

2. One static ad.

3. One ad from a different vertical whose approach could work for another brand.



Include the link and a few sentences explaining why you picked each ad, what makes it effective and what you would adapt.



We want to see your eye for creative and your judgement.

Experience with some of the following is particularly valuable:



• ChatGPT

• Claude

• Claude Projects, Skills and Connectors

• Gemini

• Higgsfield

• HeyGen

• ElevenLabs

• AI agents

• MCP servers and MCP-based integrations

• APIs and cloud-based AI workflows



You do not need to know every platform already, but you should be interested in how AI tools can be connected and used in real marketing workflows.



Marketing Automation and Lead Generation



You should understand or be willing to work with tools such as:



• n8n

• Make

• Zapier

• Clay

• Apollo

• CRM systems

• APIs and webhooks



Typical workflows may include:



• Lead scraping and prospect research

• Lead enrichment and qualification

• LinkedIn prospecting and outreach preparation

• Content research and repurposing

• CRM updates

• Reporting

• AI-assisted research

• Marketing automation



You should also have a basic understanding of marketing funnels, customer journeys, landing pages, conversion opportunities and cross-channel marketing.



What We Are Looking For



Ideally you have 2+ years of practical experience in digital marketing, social media, content creation, video editing, AI workflows, automation or lead generation.



You should have:



• Strong understanding of social media and digital marketing

• Practical video editing skills

• Experience creating modern social media content

• A good visual eye

• Strong written English

• Understanding of marketing funnels and customer journeys

• Practical experience with AI tools

• Curiosity about new AI and marketing technologies

• Ability to work independently

• Strong organisation and ownership

• Commercial thinking rather than simply task execution



Experience with Meta Ads, Google Ads, SEO, YouTube optimisation, CRM integrations, APIs or AI agents is an advantage.



You do not need to be an expert in every area.



We care more about whether you can learn quickly, connect ideas and understand how different marketing activities work together.



How We Work



We are looking for someone who:



• understands the objective behind a task

• takes ownership instead of waiting for detailed instructions

• combines creative thinking with commercial understanding

• understands audience pain points and customer behaviour

• thinks across multiple channels

• experiments with AI and emerging technologies

• looks for smarter workflows and automation opportunities

• can test ideas and improve based on performance



A question we want you to ask regularly is:



Can this be done better, faster or more intelligently?



Commitment and Compensation



• Remote position

• Approx. 6 hours per day

• Long-term cooperation

• Starting compensation: USD 400 per month

• Reliable overlap with Central European working hours, CET/CEST, is required



There is potential for increased responsibility and compensation over time based on performance and contribution.



How to Apply



Please include:



• A short introduction

• Your location and time zone

• Your availability and possible CET/CEST overlap

• Your social media and digital marketing experience

• Your video editing experience

• Your experience with AI-generated video

• Your experience with lead generation or LinkedIn prospecting

• Your experience with AI workflows and automation

• The tools you use regularly

• Your experience with Claude, Claude Skills, Connectors or MCP, if applicable

• Your experience with Higgsfield, if applicable



Portfolio Requirement



Please send at least 3 examples of work you personally created or played a significant role in creating.



Examples can include:



• Social media campaigns

• Reels or Shorts

• AI-generated video

• LinkedIn campaigns

• Lead-generation systems

• Marketing funnels

• Automation workflows

• AI workflows

• Social media graphics or carousels



For each example, briefly explain:



1. What was the objective?

2. What did you personally do?

3. Which tools did you use?

4. What was the result?

5. What would you improve if you built it again today?



Short Practical Challenge



Imagine we are working with a B2B consulting company.



The company wants to generate qualified leads through LinkedIn while also building stronger visibility through social media content.



We give you:



• a list of 500 potential companies

• several existing LinkedIn posts

• one 60-second talking-head video from the founder

• access to modern AI and automation tools



Briefly explain how you would turn this into a simple marketing system.



Please cover:



1. How would you research, enrich and qualify the right prospects?



2. How would you turn the 60-second video into a strong 20–30 second social media video?



3. How would LinkedIn content support the lead-generation activity?



4. Which parts would you automate using tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, n8n, Make, MCP, APIs or other AI tools?



5. Which parts would you intentionally not automate?



6. Which 3 metrics would you monitor first to d
 whether the system is working?



There is no single correct answer.



We want to understand how you think, how you connect different areas of marketing and whether you understand the difference between using tools and building an effective marketing system.



Important



To show that you have read the complete job description, include the word AUTOMATIONS in the first sentence of your application.



Applications without this word may not be considered.

title: Shopify Expert Needed – Recreate High-Converting Supplement Landing Page (Complete Done-for-You Project)
description:
# Shopify Expert Needed – Recreate High-Converting Supplement Landing Page (FULL Done-for-You Project)



**Job Type:** Project-Based / Freelance  

**Experience Level:** Expert  

**Budget:** Fixed Price – Please Submit Your Quote  

**Start Date:** Immediately  

**Platform:** Shopify



## PROJECT OVERVIEW



We are looking for a highly skilled Shopify developer and ecommerce designer to recreate a professional, high-converting supplement landing page for our own branded product.



**REFERENCE WEBSITE:**







**OUR PRODUCT:**



JG Nutrition – Maximum Absorption Magnesium Bisglycinate Liquid Drops (Raspberry Flavor), 2 oz bottle.



We will provide our product bottle images, branding, and access to our existing Shopify store.



Our goal is to recreate the reference website's overall design, layout, structure, visual effects, animations, and conversion-focused functionality while replacing all branding, text, images, and videos with original content for our product.



We want the finished landing page to look and perform as professionally as the reference website.



**THIS IS A COMPLETE DONE-FOR-YOU PROJECT.**



We are NOT looking for someone who only designs a mockup, creates a template, or builds a few sections.



We need someone who can manage the entire project, from initial design and content creation through Shopify development, testing, and final launch.



The finished product must be fully functional and ready to accept customer orders.



---



## SCOPE OF WORK



### 1. Recreate the Complete Reference Landing Page



Carefully analyze the reference website from top to bottom.



Recreate all major sections, including:



- Product hero section with image gallery

- Product selection and pricing options

- Add to Cart and Buy Now functionality

- Customer review and social proof sections

- Product benefit sections

- Lifestyle image sections

- Scientific and ingredient information sections

- Comparison charts and infographics

- Animated illustrations and effects

- Video testimonial galleries

- Customer experience and timeline sections

- Product comparison tables

- Frequently asked questions

- Sticky Add to Cart buttons

- Guarantee and risk-reversal sections

- Footer and supporting content



The reference website should be used as the design and functionality benchmark.



However, all text, branding, imagery, and creative assets must be customized for our JG Nutrition magnesium liquid drops.



We expect an original branded implementation, not copied source code or copyrighted creative assets.



### 2. Create ALL Product Graphics and Images



We will supply high-resolution images of our supplement bottle.



You will be responsible for creating the remaining graphics and images needed for the landing page.



These include:



- Professional product mockups

- Lifestyle photography featuring women ages 40–60

- Ingredient graphics and illustrations

- Magnesium benefit infographics

- Liquid supplement delivery illustrations

- Product comparison graphics

- Scientific-style visuals

- Icons and illustrations

- Product banners and backgrounds

- Before-and-after-style educational diagrams, where appropriate

- Mobile-optimized graphics



You should be experienced with Photoshop, Figma, Canva, AI image generation, or similar professional creative tools.



All graphics must look polished, consistent, and appropriate for a premium supplement brand.



Generic, low-quality stock graphics are not acceptable.



### 3. Recreate Animations and Visual Effects



One of the most important aspects of this project is recreating the animated elements of the reference website.



We specifically want:



**Animated Body Absorption Illustration**



An illustration of a female human body where a bright green visual effect progressively fills the body from the feet upward to the head, representing the liquid supplement delivery concept.



Additional animations may include:



- Animated percentage and progress bars

- Scroll-triggered visual effects

- Animated product benefit illustrations

- Interactive comparison sections

- Smooth transitions between sections

- Animated statistics or other graphics



All animations must display correctly on desktop and mobile devices.



They should be optimized for fast loading and smooth performance.



We are open to custom CSS, JavaScript, SVG, Lottie, video-based animation, or other appropriate technologies.



### 4. Create and Integrate Videos



The reference website uses video content throughout the landing page.



We want a similar professional presentation for our brand.



Responsibilities include:



- Creating or editing short product demonstration videos

- Producing lifestyle videos using appropriate stock or AI-generated footage

- Creating video thumbnails

- Integrating customer testimonial videos that we provide

- Building mobile-friendly video galleries

- Ensuring videos load efficiently without slowing down the page



Any AI-generated models or demonstrations must be presented appropriately and must not impersonate actual customer testimonials.



We want a visually engaging page with professional video content throughout.



### 5. Rewrite and Customize All Website Copy



The reference website sells magnesium gummies.



Our product is magnesium bisglycinate liquid drops.



All website copy must be rewritten to accurately reflect our product.



This includes:



- Main headlines

- Subheadlines

- Product benefit explanations

- Liquid delivery system messaging

- Ingredient descriptions

- Product comparisons

- Scientific information

- Calls to action

- FAQs

- Promotional messaging

- Guarantee descriptions



Copy should be persuasive, easy to understand, and focused on converting visitors into customers.



We will provide confirmed product specifications and available supporting research.



All health, ingredient, absorption, and performance claims must be supportable and appropriate for supplement marketing. Do not invent research findings, customer testimonials, clinical endorsements, or unsupported statistics.



### 6. Complete Shopify Development



The entire landing page must be built inside our existing Shopify store.



**We are NOT requiring any particular page builder or development tool.**



You should determine the best way to recreate the reference website using Shopify-compatible technology.



You may use:



- Shopify Liquid

- Custom HTML/CSS/JavaScript

- Custom Shopify theme sections

- Shopify-compatible landing page builders

- Other appropriate Shopify development solutions



The final implementation must be reliable, editable, and maintainable.



You are responsible for:



- Complete page development

- Product integration

- Pricing and product variants

- Add to Cart functionality

- Functional checkout

- Payment gateway verification

- Shipping setup verification

- Mobile responsiveness

- SEO fundamentals

- Meta Pixel integration and event testing

- Fast page loading

- Browser compatibility

- Final testing and troubleshooting



We want the page fully connected to Shopify and ready for real customer purchases.



### 7. Mobile Optimization Is Extremely Important



A significant portion of our traffic will come from
 and Instagram advertisements.



Most visitors will arrive using mobile phones.



Therefore, the mobile experience must be exceptional.



Requirements include:



- Professional mobile layouts

- Properly sized graphics and text

- Fast loading times

- Smooth mobile animations

- Easy product selection

- Prominent purchase buttons

- Functional sticky Add to Cart

- Optimized video playback

- No broken elements or horizontal scrolling



The mobile version should be just as polished and conversion-focused as the desktop version.



---



## FINAL DELIVERABLES



At project completion, we expect:



1. A fully built Shopify landing page featuring all agreed reference sections.

2. All branded product graphics and lifestyle images completed.

3. All approved animations functioning correctly.

4. All agreed videos created or integrated.

5. Original product-specific copy across the page.

6. Fully working Add to Cart, product selection, and checkout.

7. Desktop and mobile versions optimized and tested.

8. Meta Pixel and conversion events configured and verified.

9. All source files, editable graphics, and assets provided.

10. All bugs and issues corrected before final acceptance.

11. A completed, published Shopify page ready for paid advertising and customer orders.



We will provide feedback and approve designs, but the freelancer is expected to handle all actual implementation work.



**We should not have to build sections, create graphics, write code, or troubleshoot technical problems ourselves.**



## REQUIRED SKILLS



You must have strong experience with:



- Shopify ecommerce development

- Custom landing page creation

- HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Shopify Liquid

- High-converting ecommerce product pages

- Conversion rate optimization (CRO)

- Responsive and mobile-first design

- Professional graphic design

- AI image generation and image editing

- Video editing and integration

- CSS, SVG, Lottie, or JavaScript animations

- Shopify checkout and payment integration

- Ecommerce performance optimization



Previous experience with supplement, beauty, wellness, or direct-to-consumer brands is highly preferred.



## HOW TO APPLY



Please review the reference website carefully BEFORE applying.



**Reference Website:**







Then answer these questions:



**1. Portfolio:** Can you provide 2–3 LIVE Shopify landing pages you personally built that are similar in quality and complexity to our reference website?



**2. Complete Project:** Can you handle the entire project yourself, including Shopify development, graphic design, animations, video content, and page optimization?



**3. Development Approach:** After reviewing our reference website, how would you recreate it inside Shopify? Which technologies or tools would you use?



**4. Animations:** Can you recreate the body-filling absorption animation and the other effects on the reference website?



**5. Graphics:** Can you create professional product graphics, lifestyle images, and infographics based on the product bottle images we provide?



**6. Videos:** Can you create or edit the product videos and integrate the testimonial videos?



**7. Timeline:** How many calendar days will you need to complete the ENTIRE project?



**8. Fixed Price:** What is your TOTAL fixed price for the complete project, including graphics, videos, animations, development, testing, and launch? Please identify any additional software or licensing costs.



**9. Revisions:** Will you provide revisions and fix technical issues until all agreed project deliverables are completed?



**10. Availability:** Can you begin immediately?



## IMPORTANT APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS



To prove that you read the complete job description, begin your application with the following phrase:



**"MAGNESIUM SHOPIFY EXPERT"**



Applications without relevant Shopify portfolio examples or complete answers will not be considered.



We are looking for a reliable, skilled professional who takes pride in their work and can independently deliver a finished product.



Payment will be structured around agreed project milestones, with final payment after successful testing and acceptance.



We are ready to hire immediately.



**There may be opportunities for additional Shopify projects and ongoing work if this project is completed successfully.**



**PLEASE APPLY ONLY IF YOU CAN DELIVER A COMPLETE, FULLY FUNCTIONAL, CUSTOMER-READY SHOPIFY LANDING PAGE FROM START TO FINISH.**

title: Vehicle Appraisal Assistant & Client Intake VA for a US Auto Appraisal Firm (Full-Time, US Eastern Hours)
description:
About us:



Auto Praise Vehicle Evaluation Services is an independent vehicle appraisal firm in South Florida. We help car owners, attorneys and lenders with diminished value and total loss claims, usually right after an insurance company has made an offer the owner doesn't trust. We also handle fair market value appraisals for various types of vehicles, including high end exotic vehicles.



I'm Daryl, the owner and appraiser. I've spent 30+ years in the automotive and insurance claims business, and I'm hiring a full-time assistant who starts on the phones and grows into a real appraisal assistant. You'll work as "Auto Praise Office," you'll help me gather the documents, pull the reports, and assemble the finished appraisals. You’ll also handle overflow phone calls, gathering client info and leads, and following up with clients and keeping track of their data and file status. This will be an appraisal assistant and systems operator position which is why the pay climbs higher than a typical receptionist role.



What you'll do



From day one:

-Assist in organizing client/lead intake, tracking and follow up.

-Answer overflow calls when I'm on another line or out on an inspection

-Log new leads from calls, texts,
s and our website form into our Google Sheets tracker

-Follow up with clients by text,
 and phone using our templates and follow-up schedule

-Set up client folders in Google Drive when documents come in

-Organize google calendar with client data and scheduling for appraisal report work

-Prepare and send contracts (adobe sign) and invoices (QuickBooks) once a job is sold



As you grow (with training from me):



-Pull vehicle value and history reports (Black Book, J.D. Power, Carfax, Florida DMV records and other sources)

-Find comparable vehicle listings for appraisals

-Gather and organize the documents for diminished value and total loss cases

-Help assemble finished appraisal reports using the AI tools (Claude) we've built for this work



What you won't do: 



quote prices, give vehicle values, or advise clients on their claims. That stays with me, and I'll teach you exactly where that line is.



Who we're looking for



-Clear, confident spoken and written English. You're comfortable on the phone with US clients, including ones who are frustrated about their claim. This is a required skill.

-At least 1 year of customer service or phone support for US clients. Insurance, auto, claims or legal support experience is a big plus.

-Some knowledge or familiarity with automobiles/vehicles is a plus but not required.

-Solid with Google Workspace: Gmail, Drive and especially Sheets

-Detail-oriented. In this work, a wrong date, VIN or file name causes real problems.

-Happy to learn new software, including AI tools

-You follow a process, and you ask when you're not sure instead of guessing



Schedule and setup



-Full-time, 40 hours a week, Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM US Eastern with a 1-hour unpaid lunch. That's 8 PM to 5 AM Philippine time, shifting to 9 PM to 6 AM when US clocks fall back in November.

-Your own computer, a noise-cancelling headset and a quiet workspace

-Reliable internet with a backup (mobile data or a second provider) and a plan for power outages

-Long-term role, direct hire. Not an agency.



Pay and growth



-$6/hr to start while you train

-Performance reviews at 30, 60 and 90 days, as you take on the appraisal assistant work (gathering documents, pulling reports, assembling appraisals), with raises up to $10/hr

-13th-month pay once you've shown you can handle the role

-Paid time off that grows with tenure, usable for holidays or personal time, your choice: 3 paid days after 6 months, then after your first year, 1 week of paid vacation, or 2 weeks for high performers

-You're free to take Philippine holidays off. Those come from your paid days, or are unpaid once you've used them. On the rare occasion I need you on the phone during a holiday you'd normally take, I'll pay extra for that day.



How to apply



-Start your application with the words "Auto Praise Office" so I know you read the whole post.

-Answer the screening questions below.

title: Head of Customer Service – E-commerce Fashion (Refund & Chargeback Reduction)
description:
ABOUT US



We run a growing portfolio of direct-to-consumer fashion brands selling mainly to customers in the United Kingdom. We sell online through Shopify, and most of our customers find us through paid social and native advertising. Order volume is high, and every customer interaction directly affects our refund rate, chargeback rate and payment processor health.



We're looking for an experienced Head of Customer Service to own the full customer experience after purchase. Answering tickets is part of the job, but the main goal is to build a support operation that PREVENTS refunds and chargebacks before they happen.



Working hours: UK business hours (approx. 9:00-17:00 GMT/BST), Monday-Friday.





WHAT YOU'LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR



- Own all customer service channels 
, helpdesk, live chat, social DMs) and keep response times low

- Reduce refund rates by solving problems first: exchanges, store credit, partial refunds and sizing help before a full refund

- Prevent chargebacks and disputes by spotting at-risk customers early (delivery issues, "where is my order", slow replies, unhappy customers) and resolving issues before the customer goes to their bank or PayPal

- Make sure every customer conversation is clear, polite and well documented, so the customer never feels ignored or misled

- Track and report weekly KPIs: refund rate, chargeback rate, first response time, resolution time, CSAT

- Write and improve macros, SOPs and response templates with a focus on retention and dispute prevention

- Spot recurring issues (sizing, quality, shipping delays, unclear product info) and report them to management with suggested fixes

- Manage returns and exchanges end to end

- Train and manage future CS agents as the team grows



Note: You will not be responding to chargebacks yourself. Your job is to make sure customers are happy and heard, so they never feel the need to open one.





REQUIREMENTS (MUST HAVE)



- 3+ years of e-commerce customer service experience, ideally in fashion/apparel

- Proven experience reducing refunds. Please include real numbers in your application (e.g. "reduced refund rate from X% to Y%")

- A clear understanding of why customers open chargebacks and disputes (e.g. no reply, item not received, item not as described, refund taking too long) and how great customer service prevents them

- Excellent written English with a warm, natural tone suited to UK customers (including an older demographic)

- Experience with Shopify and at least one helpdesk (Gorgias, Zendesk, Re:amaze, Freshdesk or similar)

- Very organised, proactive, and comfortable working independently

- Stable internet, a quiet workspace, and a backup power source





NICE TO HAVE



- Experience leading or training a CS team

- Familiarity with order tracking tools (AfterShip, 17Track, ParcelPanel)

- Experience with UK consumer rights / return policies

- Experience in a high-volume DTC brand running paid ads





WHAT WE OFFER



- Long-term, stable full-time position

- Monthly performance bonus tied to refund and chargeback KPIs

- Room to grow into managing a full CS team

- Direct communication with the owner, no layers of management

- Paid time off and 13th month pay





HOW TO APPLY



To show us you read the full post, start your application with the subject line: "Head of CS - Chargeback Prevention"



In your application, please include:



1. A short summary of your relevant experience

2. A specific example of how you reduced refunds or prevented chargebacks/disputes, including numbers

3. Your answer to this scenario: "A customer
s saying the dress she ordered doesn't fit and she wants a full refund. She also mentions she will 'contact her bank' if this isn't sorted quickly. How would you respond?"

4. Which helpdesk tools you have used

5. Your expected monthly salary



Applications without the subject line or the scenario answer will not be considered.

title: Senior Airbnb Operations & Guest Experience Manager
description:
About the Role



We're looking for an experienced Airbnb Operations & Guest Experience Manager to oversee 8 short-term rental properties in the United States.



This is NOT a typical virtual assistant position.



We're looking for someone who thinks like a hospitality manager, communicates like a customer service professional, and understands how to maximize property revenue.



You'll be responsible for ensuring that every guest has an excellent experience, every property runs smoothly, and every opportunity to improve occupancy and revenue is explored.



We need someone who takes ownership, not someone who simply waits for instructions.



Your Key Responsibilities



1. Guest Experience & Communication



Manage guest communication from booking inquiries through checkout.

Respond promptly and professionally to guest questions and concerns.

Proactively contact guests when issues arise rather than relying solely on automated messages.

Handle check-in difficulties, late checkout requests, complaints, refunds, and special accommodations.

Know when to pick up the phone instead of continuing a conversation through chat or AI.

De-escalate difficult situations with empathy, confidence, and practical solutions.

Follow up with guests to ensure issues have actually been resolved.

Help maintain excellent Airbnb reviews and guest satisfaction.



2. Property Operations & Problem Resolution

Oversee day-to-day operations of approximately 8 Airbnb properties.

Coordinate cleaning teams, maintenance providers, and local vendors.

Handle urgent property issues such as lockouts, plumbing problems, equipment failures, and unexpected maintenance.

Coordinate alternative accommodations when a property becomes unavailable.

Provide guests with clear information, photos, and options when resolving property-related issues.

Track issues through resolution rather than simply passing them to another person.

Escalate emergencies appropriately and keep property owners informed.



3. Pricing, Occupancy & Revenue Optimization

Monitor occupancy rates, booking trends, and property performance.

Recommend dynamic pricing adjustments based on demand, seasonality, holidays, and local events.

Understand Airbnb promotions, discounts, minimum-night requirements, and last-minute booking strategies.

Identify opportunities to fill vacant dates and reduce gaps between reservations.

Review competitor listings and pricing strategies.

Recommend ways to improve listings, guest reviews, and conversion rates.

Prepare occupancy and revenue performance reports.



4. Proactive Property Management

Monitor upcoming reservations and anticipate potential problems.

Ensure properties are ready before guests arrive.

Identify recurring operational issues and recommend permanent solutions.

Improve guest communication templates and SOPs.

Coordinate proactively with cleaners and maintenance teams.

Make sound operational decisions within established guidelines.



Who We're Looking For



Required Qualifications

At least 5 years of relevant experience in Airbnb, short-term rental management, vacation rentals, or hospitality operations.

Experience managing multiple Airbnb properties simultaneously.

Strong understanding of Airbnb pricing, promotions, occupancy, and revenue management.

Excellent written and spoken English.

Proven experience handling difficult guests and urgent property issues.

Strong decision-making and problem-solving skills.

Ability to communicate confidently by phone,
, and messaging platforms.

Comfortable using technology and AI tools without depending on them to make every decision.

Willingness to provide urgent guest support outside regular working hours under an agreed on-call schedule.



Preferred Experience

Airbnb, VRBO, 

PriceLabs, Wheelhouse, Beyond Pricing

Guesty, Hospitable, Hostaway, OwnerRez

Dynamic pricing and revenue management

U.S. vacation rental markets

Guest review and reputation management



What Makes Someone Successful in This Role?

We value people who demonstrate good judgment.



For example:



A guest cannot access a property. You don't just send another automated message. You call them, troubleshoot, coordinate local assistance, and ensure they get inside.



A guest requests a late checkout. You check the cleaning schedule, next reservation, and property policies before offering a practical solution.



A property becomes unavailable due to a maintenance issue. You immediately explore alternatives, communicate clearly, and make sure the guest understands their options.



A property has several vacant nights approaching. You analyze the market, review competitors, and recommend pricing or promotional changes.



We don't want someone who only reports problems. We want someone who helps solve them.



Work Arrangement

Full-time, remote

Supporting U.S.-based Airbnb properties

Regular working hours to be agreed upon

Scheduled on-call coverage for urgent guest issues, including weekends and holidays as needed

Competitive compensation based on experience



How to Apply

Please submit your resume and answer the following questions:

How many Airbnb or short-term rental properties have you managed simultaneously?

What property management and dynamic pricing software have you used?

Describe a time a guest experienced a serious problem during their stay. What did you personally do to resolve it?

How do you determine when to adjust nightly rates or offer promotions?

A guest calls at 11 PM because they cannot enter the property. Walk us through exactly what you would do.

What would you do if one of your properties had low occupancy for the next 30 days?



Please also submit a 1–2 minute voice recording introducing yourself and explaining why you're a strong fit for this position.



We are looking for someone who can take genuine ownership of our guest experience and property operations.



If you're an experienced Airbnb operator who loves solving problems and creating excellent guest experiences, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Manual QA Tester — Content Rewards Website & User Flows
description:
Content Rewards connects creators and brands. We’re hiring a careful, curious QA tester to help us find product problems and check fixes across our creator and business experiences.



You’ll test user journeys, investigate confusing or broken behavior, and write reports that help engineers reproduce and fix issues.



ROLE DETAILS

• Part-time: 20 hours per week to start.

• Pay: US$5–$7 per hour, depending on experience.

• Longer-term opportunities are available.

• Shortlisted candidates may be invited to a paid practical trial at the agreed hourly rate.

• Test normal use, error states, and edge cases across creator and business flows.

• Coding is not required for this manual QA role.



HOW TO APPLY

title: Executive Assistant & Guest Experience Coordinator (Behind the Scenes)
description:
About us

My name is Gwen and I own a small, magical treehouse and cabin resort on 56 acres in the mountains of Maine, USA. We’re a small, hands-on team, and we’re looking for someone who wants to grow with us long term. We want you to feel like a partner in this business, not just someone taking orders.





About this role

The job is about half supporting me directly as we operate and grow the resort, and the other half is ensuring the best guest experience by running behind the scenes. I love talking with our guests and vendors, so I’ll stay the main person they hear from. This role is the person behind the scenes who makes sure everything is ready, working, and on track. You make sure the magic actually happens!



Part 1: Supporting me (about 50%, and where we’ll start)



: keeping my inbox clean and organized, drafting replies for me to review, and making sure nothing important slips through



Calendar: keeping it accurate and scheduling appointments and vendor visits around my availability



Vendors and contractors: researching options, bringing me short comparisons so I can d
 quickly, and coordinating schedules once I’ve chosen (I’ll stay the main contact)



Invoices and bills: keeping them organized in one place and flagging anything missing, late, or that doesn’t look right



Projects and paperwork: handling the behind-the-scenes work as we grow, such as permits for new projects on the property, applications, and documents



Keeping things moving: keeping our task list current and following up when we’re waiting on someone



Part 2: Guest experience behind the scenes (about 50%)



-Running the behind-the-scenes side of our booking software (Guesty): making sure everything that’s supposed to happen for each stay actually happens, like messages, door codes, and payments, and stepping in early when something doesn’t



-Keeping track of what each guest needs or is celebrating, and coordinating with our cleaning and on-site team so the special touches are ready when they arrive



-Keeping our guest materials, like welcome books and in-unit tablets, up to date and working



-Writing step-by-step guides (SOPs) for the many things we don’t have written down yet



-Backing me up on guest messages when I need it





Only apply if this is you:



-You love making people feel special



-You are very detail-oriented: you double-check things and catch problems before I (or our guests) do



-You are ridiculously organized, reliable, and willing to speak up when something looks wrong



-You take initiative and are comfortable working on your own once you’ve learned the ropes



-You are comfort with Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Sheets) and Canva



-You have at least 1–2 years of experience as a virtual or executive assistant. Hospitality or vacation rental operations experience is strongly preferred



-You may have experience with Guesty (our PMS) or experience with another booking system (Hostaway, Lodgify, OwnerRez, and similar). If no PMS experience, you have experience working in systems and can discuss how this is comparable



-You use AI tools like ChatGPT or Claude in your daily work, or you’re excited to learn





Potential Advancement:



This position can easily grow to full time by mid-2027. Wage negotiable depending on experience. We are expanding and growing, so advancement in absolutely possible.





Schedule



Tuesday to Saturday, 9am–1pm US Eastern time (9pm–1am Philippine time) for the first 30 days, so we can work together while I train you

After that, hours are negotiable as long as everything is ready for our cleaning team each day





How we work



At the start, I’ll review anything that goes to guests/vendors/contractors before it’s sent. As we learn together, I hope to get you working on your own quickly.

A 60-day introduction period so we can both make sure it’s a good fit

Paid weekly through Wise





How to apply



Please
 us with the subject line “Treehouse Assistant – [Your Name]” and include:



1) If you've used a booking or property management software you’ve used. What tasks did you complete?

2) A time you caught a problem before it reached a guest or customer.

3) A short example of a special touch you’ve created for a guest or customer, or something you've done for a family or friend.

4) What you think is the most important aspect of supporting your boss in an executive assistant role.



***Shortlisted applicants will be invited to a short paid test task.***



Thank you for applying!



Warmly,

Gwen

title: Financial & Operations
description:
Financial & Operations Controller + Cash Collection + Bookkeeper



Keywords: Xero, Google Sheets Expert, Finance Controller, Logistics Coordinator, 3PL, Fashion Operations, Accounts Receivable



About the role



We are an international luxury fashion company shipping collections from China to the EU, USA and Asia through a 3PL partner. We are looking for a Financial & Operations Controller to take control of our cash collection, shipment tracking and payment administration. This is a 6-month bridge position, with the possibility of extension.





All of our operational and financial tracking runs in Google Sheets. You will own that system.





Responsibilities

 



 •. Collect outstanding balances on past seasons

 • Collect deposits for the upcoming season

 • Track all inbound and outbound shipments through the 3PL

 • Give direct instructions to the 3PL and monitor execution

 • Follow up with our warehouse contact on deliveries

 • Prepare and track payments to the 3PL, suppliers and vendors

 • Reconcile customer payments against orders and invoices

 • Build and maintain our Xero environment 

 • Help design the structure that will take over when the 6-month period ends



Requirements



 • Proven experience in the fashion or apparel industry, including seasonal collections and deposits

 • Solid knowledge of Xero, logistics and 3PL operations, including how goods move from China to the EU, USA and Asia

 • Experience in accounts receivable, accounts payable and payment follow-up

 • Advanced Xero, Google Sheets skills: QUERY, ARRAYFORMULA, XLOOKUP, IMPORTRANGE, dashboards and automation (Apps Script is an advantage)

 • Dashboards that work reliably on iPhone and iPad

 • Assertive communicator, comfortable negotiating with suppliers, customers and logistics partners

 • Strong attention to detail and a careful approach to company funds

title: Logistics Virtual Assistant 30-day paid trial · Remote · 15 hrs/week · USD $7.50/hr
description:
Logistics Virtual Assistant

30-day paid trial · Remote · 15 hrs/week · USD $7.50/hr

Chameleon Science Pty Ltd · Australia



About the role

Chameleon Science sells research reagents to laboratories across Australia and New Zealand, sourced

from suppliers in the US, Europe and China. We handle 7–10 customer orders a week. Every order has

to be quoted, ordered from the supplier, cleared through Australian biosecurity, held at the right

temperature, delivered and invoiced.

You will run that process end to end, following our Order Logistics SOP. The role starts with logistics and

can grow into general admin.

We are looking for someone who follows a process carefully and then tells us how to make it better. If

you spot something that does not add up, we want you to stop and ask rather than push it through.

What you will own

Every order, from the customer's first request to delivery:

1. Quote the customer. Build quotes in Xero with correct pricing, freight (standard, blue ice or dry ice)

and lead time. Send them and log the deal in Pipedrive.

2. Take in orders. Check each customer PO against the quote, acknowledge it the same day, and

choose the shipping route.

3. Order from the supplier. Raise purchase orders in Xero in the supplier's currency. Track

confirmations, backorders and ship dates.

4. Prepare import paperwork. Send suppliers our import permit and manufacturer's declaration

template. Check the signed declaration matches the permit word for word.

5. Pre-clear and track. Send FedEx the clearance documents, track inbound shipments daily, and

answer customs queries the same day.

6. Arrange delivery. Brief our Sydney logistics partner, book couriers before the daily cutoff, and

manage cold-chain and dry-ice shipments.

7. Invoice. Send one Xero invoice per order at dispatch, with courier and tracking number.

8. Close out. Record delivery, keep Pipedrive and the shipment spreadsheet current, and enter

supplier bills in Xero.

Across every step:

• Answer overnight supplier questions first thing, before US and EU cutoffs.

• Check the orders@, accounts@ and info@ inboxes every day.

• Keep customers informed of ETAs and delays before they have to ask.

• Flag anything that does not match — prices, cartons, paperwork — before acting on it.

What stays with Kathryn during the trial

These decisions do not route to you in the first 30 days:

• Manufacturers declarations — you check them, Kathryn approves each one before the supplier is

told to ship.

• Courier and freight spend — ask before booking or approving.

• Permit wording for new product types — checked case by case.

• Overdue-invoice chasing — not part of the trial.

• FedEx import freight and duty invoices — Kathryn codes these in Xero.

Logins to FedEx, Toll, Team Global Express, Logistics 360, Xero, Pipedrive and the shipment

spreadsheet are set up on day one.

How hiring works

Step 1 — Application

Send a short note covering your logistics or order-processing experience and the systems you have

used, plus a 2-minute video introducing yourself.

Put DRY ICE as the first word of your subject line. Applications without it are not read — this role is

about reading instructions carefully, and this is the first test.

Step 2 — Paid test project

Shortlisted applicants complete a paid 2-hour task built from a real order: check a set of order

documents, quote it, and tell us what to do next. Paid at the hourly rate above regardless of outcome.

Step 3 — 30-day paid trial

A paid, fixed-term engagement. It is a fair test both ways: you see whether the work suits you, and we

see whether you can run orders with less and less help.

The 30 days

Week Focus Done when

1 Learn the SOP, systems and partners.

Shadow live orders.



You can explain each step and know what

routes back to Kathryn.



2 Run quotes, PO intake and supplier POs, with

Kathryn checking.



Quotes and POs go out correct and same-

day.

3 Run import paperwork, tracking and dispatch,

with Kathryn checking.



Shipments pre-cleared and dispatched with

no missed cutoffs.



4 Run the full process end to end. Propose

improvements.



Most orders need no correction, and you

have proposed at least one SOP

improvement.



At the end we review together against four measures:

• Orders processed correctly from quote to invoice.

• Supplier and courier cutoffs met.

• Pipedrive, Xero and the shipment spreadsheet matching reality at the end of each day.

• Problems flagged early, with a clear question or a suggested fix.

If it goes well the role continues, with a long-term decision at around 90 days.

What you will need

Essential

• Experience in order processing, logistics, import/export or e-commerce admin.

• Strong attention to detail — you will match documents word for word and number for number.

• Clear written English for suppliers, customers, FedEx and couriers.

• Comfort working across several systems at once and keeping them in sync.

• Reliability with deadlines, and the judgement to ask before guessing.

• A process mindset: follow the SOP, then improve it.

Nice to have

• Xero, Pipedrive or another CRM.

• International freight, customs clearance or courier bookings.

• Cold-chain or dangerous goods (dry ice) shipping.

• Experience with Australian businesses or the life sciences.

• Using AI tools to work faster.

Terms

Contract Independent contractor, 30-day paid trial, extendable in further 30-day blocks.

Pay USD $7.50 per hour, paid fortnightly.

Hours 15 hours per week, Monday to Friday.

Overlap Daily start by 6:00am Manila time (9:00am Sydney) to clear overnight supplier


. Courier bookings must be placed before 12:00pm Manila (3:00pm Sydney).



Location Remote. Philippines preferred.

Start Monday 2 November 2026.

Reports to Kathryn Friend, Founder.

Systems Xero, Pipedrive, Gmail, Google Drive and Sheets, FedEx, Toll, Team Global



Express, Logistics 360.



Reporting A short end-of-day update: what shipped, what is waiting, what needs Kathryn.



Key dates

• Applications close: Friday 16 October 2026.

• Paid test projects: week of 19 October.

• Offer made: by Friday 30 October.

• Trial starts: Monday 2 November.

 with the subject line "Screen recorder - " and answer these four questions:

We are a small, fully remote team working closely together every day in Slack. We have a weekly team meeting where everyone joins, and despite the distance it genuinely feels like a team - people help each other, celebrate wins together, and nobody is left alone with a problem. Several of our team members are based in the Philippines and have been with us for a long time.

All our UGC creators and our creator program on Trybe

Keeping them creating: motivating creators to make more videos and sharing new briefs and winning angles with them

Creative performance: learning which videos, hooks and angles perform in our ads, and turning that into better briefs and feedback

Reviewing submitted videos against the brief and giving clear, kind feedback

Investing extra time in our best creators so they stay with us

Building a real creator community: group chats, broadcasts, recognition and small rewards

Delivering approved content to our ads agency every day and keeping ClickUp, our tracker and your daily EOD report updated

No experience needed - we train you in everything. Experience with social media, influencers or UGC is a plus

Excellent written English, and comfortable using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) to write natural messages in Danish

You follow processes carefully and ask when something is unclear

Reliable internet and backup power



Working hours: Full-time, 40 hours/week. Your schedule is flexible, but at least 6 of your hours must fall between 8 AM and 5 PM Danish time, and you must be logged in no later than 9 AM Danish time every weekday. Denmark switches between summer and winter time, so in Philippine time that means logging in by 3 PM during Danish summer time (end of March to end of October) and by 4 PM during Danish winter time. Hey there! We’re looking for a true SEO expert, someone beyond the basics who understands how to craft data-driven, search-optimized websites that actually rank.



You should be someone who:

- Has strong experience in On-Page SEO, keyword research, meta optimization, internal linking, and content structure

- Knows how to plan, optimize, and refine title tags, meta descriptions, headers, and keyword distribution for best results

- Can perform SEO audits and fix on-page issues (thin content, missing alt text, indexing issues, etc.)

- Understands how to get pages indexed and diagnose issues in Google Search Console

- Ideally already has access to tools Ahrefs or Semrush

- Has experience with Google My Business (GMB) optimization and local SEO basics

- Works with WordPress + Rank Math

- Bonus* Has their own reporting templates, checklists, or SEO docs they’ve already refined, something they can reuse and apply to our workflow



The type of work you’ll Be Doing:



Primary Tasks:

- Perform keyword research for client websites (mainly luxury villas & vacation rentals business with multiple properties)

- Optimize page titles, meta descriptions, headings, and content for target keywords

- Sets up Google Search Console/Google Analytics

- Handle ALT text on images

- Ensure all pages are properly indexed and structured for Google visibility

- Clean up on-page SEO issues flagged by Rank Math or Google Search Console



You’ll work closely with a designer and developer to shape websites that are both visually beautiful and search-optimized.

Right now, we’re focused on per-project, one-time SEO work, helping optimize each new site we launch. 



This job is perfect for those who are talented, value their time, and already have work and looking for extra work to do. You’ll have creative input and flexibility. We’ll look to you for best practices, efficient processes, and new ideas to improve our SEO approach. This rewards smart, experienced professionals who can deliver high-quality results efficiently.



Job Perks:

???? Work on beautiful, design-driven websites for luxury villas and vacation rentals

 ???? Help real businesses grow visibility and bookings

 ?? Flexible, results-focused work (no hour tracking)

 ???? Fully remote — work whenever and wherever you’re most productive

 ???? Long-term growth potential as we expand our SEO services



About Me:

Hi, I’m Jack. The founder of Villa Vision Builders, a boutique web agency that creates conversion-focused websites for short-term rentals and vacation properties. We help property owners save on Airbnb fees, build their brand, and get more direct bookings through beautifully designed, high-performing websites. Now we’re ready to take the next step, optimizing every website for search visibility and real-world rankings. Website: 



How to Apply:

Please include the following in your application:

- A few sentences on why you’re a great fit for this SEO role

- An example of a website you’ve optimized (and what specific SEO work you did)

- What SEO tools do you currently use/have access to (i.e. Semrush/Ahrefs)

- Have you worked on vacation rental, real estate, or hospitality websites before?

- Optional: A screenshot/example of an SEO report, template or SOP you use for your work

- Subject line: “I’m interested in SEO for VVB”

title: AI Video Ad Editor: AI Drama, Song & UGC Ads for DTC Brands
description:
THE JOB



We run several e-commerce brands and spend on Meta every day. We need an editor who makes AI ads from start to finish: AI drama ads, AI song ads, and AI UGC.



You take an angle from our list, storyboard it, generate the clips, cut them to the song or voiceover, caption it, and deliver the hook variants and language versions. We approve the storyboard. After that it's yours until it's done.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



• You've made AI ads for direct-response brands. The long-form AI drama and song ads that top supplement and wellness brands are scaling right now. Think Resilia, Rosabella and Ultimate Peak. Show us ads you made at that level and tell us which brands.



• You know kie.ai and the models on it: Seedance, Kling, Veo, Nano Banana, Suno, ElevenLabs. You know why a shot comes out wrong and how to re-prompt it. Character consistency across a whole ad is normal for you.



• You're active on X. You follow the AI ads scene, see what's working this week and post your own work. Send your handle. No X account, no interview.



• AI UGC that looks real and short-form editing that holds attention: hard cuts, the payoff or curiosity line in the first second, captions 2–4 words at a time.



• You can follow a brand style guide exactly. Our brands look nothing alike.



• A plus: you've done a DTC creative course (or a similar program for ecom ad editors).



• Clear English, fast replies, and you tell us before something is late, not after.



RULES EVERY AD FOLLOWS



• 9:16 only, everything important inside the centred square.

• Captions only. No logo, price or end card.

• Sound always on. Hard cuts, no crossfades.

• The picture shows exactly what the line says.

• Every ad gets new scenes. Nothing reused.

• Never invent numbers, reviews or claims.

• All generation runs through kie.ai on our account.



HOW IT WORKS



1. Paid test. One short ad from a storyboard we give you. You get paid whether we hire you or not.

2. First month. A fixed batch of ads across our brands.

3. Ongoing. Several brands testing constantly. Deliver well and both volume and pay grow.

4. Uncapped performance bonus. When your ads win, you earn more. There is no ceiling.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the word "HARDCUT". Applications without it are not read.



1. Your X handle.

2. 3 AI ads you made (links), and the brand each one was for. Drama or song ads first if you have them.

3. Which AI tools you use every day, and whether you've used kie.ai.

4. One shot that came out wrong and how you fixed it. Model, prompt change, result.

5. How many ads per week you can deliver and when you can start.

title: Senior SDR / B2B Cold Calling & Appointment Setting – US Technology Company
description:
# Senior SDR / B2B Cold Calling & Appointment Setting – US Technology Company



**Full-Time | Remote (Philippines) | US Eastern Business Hours**



**Salary: ₱65,000–₱85,000/month + Performance Bonuses**



### About the Position



We are an established US-based Managed IT Services and Cybersecurity company seeking an experienced Sales Development Representative (SDR) to build and execute our outbound prospecting program.



**We are NOT looking for a beginner or someone who requires constant supervision.**



We want an experienced, self-motivated sales professional who knows how to find prospects, make cold calls, engage business decision-makers, and consistently schedule qualified appointments.



**This is a hands-on position. You will personally make outbound cold calls every day.**



### Your Responsibilities



- Make daily outbound cold calls to US business owners and decision-makers.

- Identify prospective customers, build targeted calling lists, and research contacts.

- Qualify opportunities and schedule appointments with genuinely interested prospects.

- Recommend and help implement prospecting tools such as Apollo, ZoomInfo, or similar platforms.

- Develop and improve calling scripts, outreach campaigns, and follow-up processes.

- Independently manage your prospecting pipeline and CRM activities.

- Track performance, identify problems, and proactively improve results.



### What We're Looking For



- **3+ years of proven B2B outbound cold-calling experience**, preferably targeting US businesses.

- Demonstrated success booking qualified sales appointments.

- Excellent spoken English and confident telephone communication.

- Experience with prospecting tools, CRM platforms, and lead generation.

- Ability to build and manage an outbound prospecting process independently.

- Strong initiative, accountability, organization, and problem-solving skills.

- MSP, cybersecurity, IT services, or SaaS sales experience is highly preferred.



### Independence Is Essential



We will explain our services, ideal customers, and sales objectives. However, we expect you to bring the expertise needed to manage the prospecting process.



If you need prospecting software, recommend it. If you need leads, know how to find them. If an approach isn't working, improve it.



**We want someone who takes ownership of results—not someone waiting for daily instructions.**



This is not a management-only role. The majority of your time should be spent actively prospecting, making calls, and generating qualified appointments.



### How to Apply



Please answer these questions in your application:



1. How many years of US B2B cold-calling experience do you have?

2. How many calls per day and qualified appointments per month did you average in your most recent role?

3. Have you ever independently built or improved an outbound prospecting process? Briefly explain.

4. What prospecting tools, dialers, and CRM systems have you used?

5. If hired to build our outbound appointment-setting process, what would your first 30 days look like?

6. Please include a short voice recording (60–90 seconds) introducing yourself and describing your sales experience.

7. What is your expected monthly salary in PHP?



**Generic applications or applications without answers to these questions will not be considered.**



We're looking for a proven, independent sales professional who enjoys cold calling, takes initiative, and wants a long-term opportunity with a growing US technology company.

title: Ai eCommerce Video Editor
description:

- Taking ownership of creative execution from start to finish.

- **Previous experience working within Shopify D2C e-commerce brands. Non-negotiable.**

- Strong AI video production and editing skills.

- Experience creating direct-response ads across multiple formats.

- Proficiency with **Asana, Slack, and 
**.

- Good written and spoken English.

- Ability to work independently without step-by-step instructions.

- Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-volume production environment.



**Bonus:** Experience using Suno AI for song-based ads.



### Who You Are

- **Hungry & Ambitious:** You thrive in a fast-paced team that moves quickly, pushes standards, and wants to win.

- **Coachable:** You listen, take feedback well, and implement changes quickly without ego or defensiveness.

- **Accountable:** You take full ownership of your work, deadlines, and output. No chasing or micromanaging required.

- **Reliable & Disciplined:** You show up consistently, arrive on time to meetings, communicate clearly, and follow SOPs strictly.

- **Growth-Minded:** You're constantly improving your editing skills, experimenting with new AI tools, and staying ahead of creative trends.

- **Performance-Driven:** You care about results, not just making videos look good. You understand that the goal is to create ads that convert.
