title: Billing Specialist
description:
It has to make sense. That is the standard at Divorce With A Plan. Not "close enough." Not "that is just how billing works." It has to make sense to the client, or we have not done our job.



Clients are high-net-worth professionals going through divorce across the state of Maryland. They are intelligent, capable people navigating a financial experience they were never trained for. They do not know what an evergreen retainer is. They do not know what a trust replenishment request means or why it matters. And if no one explains it in a way that makes sense to them, they lose confidence in the process, and they lose sight of the plan they are working toward.



That is the problem this role solves.



The Billing Specialist at Divorce With A Plan is the person who makes the financial side of a divorce case make sense to the client. You walk beside them from the day they retain the firm through the day the case closes, connecting every payment to the outcome they are working toward. You are part of their walk. You are the one who helps them see that the $5,000 retainer replenishment is not just a number. It is the next step toward the custody arrangement they need, the property division that protects their future, the agreement that lets them move forward.



The time you spend with clients explaining their billing, answering their questions, and making sure their plan still makes sense to them is not an extra. It is not a favor. It is part of the service. There is no additional cost to the client for the time you invest in making sure they understand. That is how this firm works, and it is one of the reasons clients trust us.



How we do it: the right way.



This firm runs on structure. There is a defined process for everything, because when the process is clear, the client gets a consistent experience no matter which attorney is on their case or which week of the month it is. You will have a daily call block schedule so clients are never waiting days for a return call. You will have a billing script built on the Maryland Rules of Professional Conduct so clients hear accurate, compliant information every time. You will have an escalation protocol with documented timestamps, so no client concern sits unaddressed. You will have a weekly deliverable that captures how clients are feeling, what they need, and what feedback they are giving us, so the firm can respond to what clients are actually experiencing, not what we assume they are experiencing.



If you are someone who finds relief in knowing exactly what the standard is, exactly what a good day looks like, and exactly what is expected, keep reading.



What you produce: a contribution that protects the client and the firm.



The Maryland Rules of Professional Conduct require that clients be kept informed about the status of their matter (Rule 1.4), that fees are reasonable and clearly communicated (Rule 1.5), and that client funds held in trust are safeguarded with precision (Rule 1.15). Those rules exist to protect the client. Everything this role does is built around upholding them.



Every call you make either keeps a client informed or it does not. Every replenishment conversation either connects the payment to the client's goals and gives them the information they are entitled to, or it leaves them making financial decisions without the full picture. Every trust balance you monitor either gets flagged the same day it drops below threshold, protecting the client's funds and the firm's fiduciary obligation, or it becomes the kind of gap that puts both at risk.



You are not here to process invoices. You are here to contribute to something that matters: a client's ability to get through the hardest financial experience of their life with clarity, dignity, and a plan that makes sense to them, while ensuring the fir
ets the professional standards that make all of that possible. Here is who thrives in this role.



You genuinely like people. Not in theory. In practice. You are energized by 20+ phone conversations a day because you actually want to know how someone is doing, and they can tell the difference. You remember that a client's daughter just started high school, that another client lost their job two months ago, that someone told you in March they were scared about the mediation in May, and when you call in May, you ask about it before you ask about the balance.







You are organized because you cannot function without a system. You manage 100 to 150 active client relationships, and nothing falls through because you built something (a spreadsheet, a calendar, a color-coded tracker, a handwritten list) that keeps you moving. You do not wait for someone to tell you what needs attention. You see the attorney's calendar, you see the hearing in two weeks, and you pick up the phone, because the client deserves to know what is coming before it arrives.



You have the emotional range to sit with a client who is crying about their financial situation on Tuesday and have a firm, direct conversation about a past-due balance on Wednesday, and both conversations are authentic because both come from the same place: you care about this person's outcome, and you are going to tell them the truth.



You have been described as "the person who can get anyone to pay," and you know the reason is not pressure. It is trust. People pay you because you took the time to help them understand what they were paying for and why it mattered to their case.



Here is who this role is not for.

1. If you want to process invoices in a back office and never talk to a client, this role will make you miserable.

2. If you avoid difficult conversations about money, you will not survive the first month. These clients are going through a divorce. Money is emotional. You need to be able to hold that space and still move the conversation forward, because the client needs someone who will stay in it with them.

3. If you need someone to tell you what to do every hour, this is not the right structure for you. You will have clear expectations, daily blocks, and weekly deliverables. Within that framework, you think, prioritize, and act. Problems get fixed or flagged, because a problem that sits is a client who waits.



If you read from a script without understanding why each line exists, you will fail here. Every call requires context. You know what is happening in the client's case before you dial, and you lead with that, because a client who feels known is a client who stays engaged in their own plan.



If the phrase "it has to make sense" does not resonate with you at a gut level, if you are comfortable with "good enough" or "that is just how we do it," you will not be happy working here.



Responsibilities

1. Make the Financial Side of the Case Make Sense from Day One

2. Within five business days of retention, deliver a billing tutorial covering retainer structure, evergreen replenishment, invoice format, and what to expect at each stage, so the client starts their case understanding how the financial side works before they receive their first invoice.

3. Conduct a live introductory call to walk through the material, answer questions, and establish the relationship. This call gives the client a person they can reach when billing feels confusing, and it gives you the context to serve them well for the life of their case.

4. Provide specific dollar ranges for upcoming cost events (hearings: $5,000-$10,000, mediations, trials: $15,000-$30,000) so the client can plan ahead instead of reacting to surprises.

5. Introduce yourself as a non-billable point of contact. The time you spend making sure their plan still makes sense to them is part of the service, not an add-on. Clients who know they can call you without a meter running are clients who stay informed and engaged.

6. Keep Trust Accounts Funded by Keeping Clients Informed

7. Monitor trust balances daily across
active matters so no client's case is disrupted by a funding gap they did not see coming.

8. Call every client before sending a replenishment request. No email goes out without a phone call attempt. The call comes first because the client deserves a conversation, not a demand.

9. When requesting additional retainers for upcoming events, reference the specific event by name and the date you first discussed it. This tells the client you are paying attention to their case, not just their balance.

10. Flag any matter below the trust threshold the same day. Not at the next billing cycle. The same day. A delay means the client's case could stall without warning.

11. Process Invoices the Right Way

12. Prepare, review, and distribute client invoices on a biweekly cycle, so clients receive accurate, consistent billing they can follow.

13. Review every time entry on every invoice for accuracy, specificity, and consistency. Flag entries that are vague, duplicative, or do not reflect the actual work performed, because a confusing invoice erodes the client's trust in the firm.

15. Contact timekeepers directly to resolve questionable entries before pre-bills go to attorneys. The client should never have to question whether an entry is real.

17. Distribute finalized invoices on the scheduled date with payment links included so clients always know what they owe and how to pay without chasing anyone down.

18. Collect by Connecting Payment to Progress

19. Maintain accounts receivable below 2% of total billings.

20. Execute 12-15 outbound calls per day during the morning AR block, with every call documented in Clio so the client's history is always current if another tea
mber needs to step in.

21. Lead every collections conversation with a case update: what was accomplished, what is upcoming, and how the work connects to the client's goal. The client hears the value before they hear the number.

22. When a client says they cannot pay, walk through every option: credit cards, personal loans, family support, employer assistance, and legal fee financing. You do not accept "I cannot" without helping them look at every door first, because a client who feels they have no options may abandon a case they still need.

23. Send payment links the same day after any commitment so the client can act while the conversation is fresh.

24. Listen, Learn, and Report What Clients Need

Pay attention to what clients tell you on every call. Their questions, their frustrations, their confusion, and their feedback are data the firm needs to hear so we can serve them better.

25. Produce a weekly deliverable every Friday, capturing client feedback, recurring questions, unresolved needs, and what you are hearing about the client experience. This is how the firm stays connected to what clients actually need instead of guessing.

26. When a billing concern arises, log it with a documented timestamp and route it to the responsible attorney via email so the client gets a response, not silence.

27. Escalate any concern involving bar grievance, fraud, or legal action language to firm leadership the same day, because those situations require immediate attention to protect the client and the firm.

28. Stay Ahead of the Attorneys

Check attorney calendars for upcoming hearings, mediations, and trials. Initiate additional retainer requests before anyone asks, so the client has time to prepare instead of scrambling.

29. Confirm all credits, write-offs, and billing holds in writing before any related bill is finalized. If a credit is pending and you are not certain it has been applied, hold the bill. A client should never receive an invoice that does not reflect what the firm already knows.

30. Document every retainer reduction, billing pause, or special instruction in Clio at the matter level the same day so the next person who touches the file has the full picture and the client never has to repeat themselves.



Qualifications

Required:

 • 2+ years in billing, collections, or accounts receivable in a professional services environment. Law firm experience strongly preferred.

 • High comfort with outbound phone calls and client-facing conversations. This role requires 20+ calls per day. If phones drain you, this is not the right fit.

 • Proficiency with practice management software (Clio Manage preferred, or ability to learn within 30 days).

 • Ability to read and interpret legal invoices, time entries, trust account statements, and engagement agreements.

 • Strong written communication for documented escalations, client correspondence, and weekly deliverables.

 • Proficiency with Google Workspace (Gmail, Sheets, Calendar, Drive).

 • Demonstrated ability to manage 100+ active relationships simultaneously without dropping threads.



Preferred

 • Experience in a family law firm or litigation practice.

 • Familiarity with the Maryland Rules of Professional Conduct as they relate to billing. Training provided, but baseline awareness accelerates onboarding.

 • Experience with evergreen retainer models and trust accounting.

 • Prior use of LawPay, Dialpad, or Clio Grow.

 • Bilingual (English/Spanish) is a plus.



About Divorce with a Plan

Benefits / Why Work Here

 • Fully remote. We serve clients across the entire state of Maryland. You work from wherever you work best.

 • A firm that builds systems so clients get a consistent experience. You will have scripts, checklists, escalation protocols, a daily structure, and technology supporting you from day one.

 • Direct impact you can measure. Your collections rate, your AR percentage, the client feedback you surface: you will see exactly how your work makes a difference for real people going through real situations.

 • Training on the Maryland Rules of Professional Conduct as they apply to billing. This gives you compliance knowledge that transfers to any law firm career and ensures every client interaction meets the standard.



How to Apply

 • Please submit your resume and a brief cover letter outlining your legal billing experience, familiarity with trust accounting, and any experience with Clio or similar platforms. Bilingual candidates are encouraged to note their language proficiency.

 • As part of the application process, please also complete the initial interview using the link below:

 • Initial AI Interview Link: 

 • Applications that include both a resume and completed initial interview will be prioritized.

• At least 2+ years of paralegal or legal assistant experience.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and CMS.

• Ability to handle sensitive information with discretion, professionalism, and integrity.

• Comfortable working independently in a remote environment with minimal supervision.

title: Appointment Setter – Base + Uncapped Commission | $600–$1,500+ OTE
description:
Appointment Setter – $200 Base + Uncapped Commission | $600–$1,500+ OTE



OTE means on-target earnings. The $600–$1,500+ range is based on achieving approximately 6–8 qualified meetings and generating 1–2 new clients per month. Actual earnings will depend on performance, client pricing, conversions, and retention.



About Us

We are a small Amazon advertising agency that helps founder-led brands grow profitably on Amazon. We're growing and looking for a reliable appointment setter to help us connect with more Amazon brand owners.



What you'll do

- Call founders and owners of small Amazon brands from a lead list we provide, using our parallel dialer

- Offer them a free competitor breakdown for their brand

- Book 15-minute intro calls on our founder's calendar

- Log every call outcome and follow up with interested brands

- Respect every "not interested" or "don't call me" right away



Pay

- $200/month base pay (paid twice a month)

- $30 for each of your first 8 qualified meetings held during the month (paid weekly)

- $40 for each additional qualified meeting held after the first 8 (paid weekly)

- 50% of the first monthly payment collected from each new client generated through your qualified meeting

- 10% of that client's monthly fee for their first six paid months

- No cap on earnings



Signing commissions are paid after the client's first payment clears and the client completes 30 days without a refund or chargeback. Recurring commissions are paid monthly for the client's first six paid months.



What one signed client can earn you:

- $750/month client: $375 signing commission + $450 over six months = $825

- $1,500/month client: $750 signing commission + $900 over six months = $1,650



What counts as a qualified meeting

- You spoke directly with the founder or Amazon decision-maker

- The company actively sells its own brand on Amazon

- The company fits the target profile provided during training

- The prospect expressed genuine interest in the complimentary competitor breakdown or Amazon advertising support

- The meeting was generated through your outreach and actually takes place

- The prospect was not already active in our pipeline



Workload

- About 10–15 hours of calling per week

- A calling block during US business hours that we agree on together

- A minimum of 10 calling hours per week

- All call outcomes logged before the end of each session

- Follow-ups completed on schedule



What we provide

- A parallel dialer and lead lists

- A short script and an easy offer (the free competitor breakdown)

- Training on our process and common objections

- Direct communication with the founder



What you need

- Clear, confident spoken English

- Cold calling or appointment setting experience (B2B preferred)

- Comfort handling objections politely and staying professional

- Reliable internet and a quiet place to work

- Availability for 10–15 hours per week during US business hours



Nice to have

- Experience with ecommerce, Amazon sellers or marketing agencies

- Experience using a parallel or power dialer



How it works

- This is an independent contractor role

- We start with a paid 2-week trial ($100 base for the trial period, plus all meeting and client commissions you earn)

- Setters who meet our quality, reliability, and performance standards may be offered a long-term position

- After 60 days, strong performers will be eligible for a compensation review, a higher base, and additional responsibility as the company grows

- You must follow our calling rules, including Do Not Call requirements



How to apply

1. Send a 1–2 minute voice recording responding to this scenario: You have reached the founder of a small Amazon brand for the first time. Introduce yourself, briefly explain why you are calling, and offer the complimentary competitor breakdown.

2. Answer briefly:

   - How many years of cold calling or appointment setting experience do you have, and in which industries?

   - On average, how many meetings did you book per week in your last role?

   - What hours (in US Eastern Time) are you available?



We review every application and reply to shortlisted candidates within a few days.

title: Technical Executive Assistant | Web, Marketing & AI Tools (Long-Term)

title: Practice Administrator | Australian Accounting Firm | Xero Practice Manager
description:
Job Summary



We are looking for an organised and detail-oriented Practice Administrator to support an Australian accounting firm.



This role is primarily administrative. You will help manage client records, workflows, deadlines, onboarding, compliance documentation and day-to-day practice operations. You will also assist with invoicing, payment follow-ups and client communications.



The ideal candidate has at least 2 years of administration experience in an Australian accounting practice and understands how accounting firms manage client information, compliance deadlines and practice workflows.



You do not need to be responsible for preparing tax returns or performing complex accounting work. Instead, you will help ensure that administrative tasks are completed accurately, deadlines are monitored, documents are collected and work is ready for the Director's review and approval.



Key Responsibilities



Practice Administration and Workflow Management



Maintain client jobs, workflow stages, task statuses and due dates in Xero Practice Manager (XPM).



Monitor deadlines and follow up on outstanding tasks to keep work progressing.



Ensure client and entity details, including names, ABNs, ACNs and relevant dates, are accurate across systems.



Maintain organised client records, compliance checklists and electronic filing systems.



Track documents requiring signatures and ensure completed documents are saved correctly.



Client Onboarding and Documentation



Assist with onboarding new clients by collecting required information and supporting documents.



Coordinate identity verification, customer due diligence and conflict-check documentation.



Prepare engagement letters and related documents from templates for Director review and approval.



Follow up on outstanding information, signed documents and prior-year accounting records.



Assist with client-agent linking through ATO Online Services for agents, where required.



ASIC and Company Administration



Monitor ASIC annual review dates and prepare the relevant documentation for review and approval.



Coordinate signing documents and follow up on outstanding requirements.



Prepare draft company forms, including Forms 484 and 362, based on approved instructions.



Maintain company registers, officeholder details and corporate records.



Assist with preparing minutes, resolutions, dividend statements and share transfer documentation using templates.



Invoicing and Client Communication



Prepare client invoices in Xero Practice Manager and follow up on overdue payments.



Draft routine client
s, including requests for information, signing reminders and tax payment notifications, for Director approval.



Assist with diary management, appointment scheduling and client follow-ups.



Coordinate with external service providers when documentation or additional information is required.



Quality Checks and General Administration



Review automated or AI-assisted outputs for accurate client details, dates, amounts and supporting information.



Ensure documents are complete, properly filed and ready for review before anything is sent externally.



Help maintain efficient administrative processes and ensure outstanding items are followed through.



Required Experience and Skills



At least 2 years of administration experience within an Australian accounting practice.



Practical experience using Xero Practice Manager (XPM) to manage client records, jobs, workflows or deadlines.



Familiarity with Xero and the general administrative processes of an Australian accounting firm.



Understanding of ATO client-agent linking and ATO Online Services for agents.



Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple clients, tasks and deadlines.



Excellent attention to detail when checking client information and preparing documents.



Clear written English and professional client communication skills.



Confidence following up on outstanding information, documents and payments.



Ability to work independently, maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive client information.



Highly Regarded

Experience preparing draft ASIC Forms 484 and 362, maintaining company registers, and preparing minutes or resolutions.



Familiarity with engagement letters, client onboarding and identity verification procedures.



Experience with electronic signing platforms such as SignNow or similar.



Familiarity with Microsoft 365, OneDrive and AI-assisted administrative workflows.



Certificate IV in Accounting and Bookkeeping or a related qualification.



Important Note



This is a practice administration role, not a Senior Accountant or tax preparation position. We are looking for someone who understands the administrative operations of an Australian accounting practice and can manage workflows, documentation, client follow-ups and compliance deadlines accurately.

title: B2B Appointment Setter / Cold Caller
description:
B2B Appointment Setter / Cold Caller - $500 USD + Uncapped Performance Bonuses

Velo Systems

Full-Time | Remote | 9 AM - 5 PM Eastern Time

$500 USD/month base + uncapped performance bonuses



ABOUT VELO SYSTEMS

Velo Systems helps established med spas improve how they handle inbound calls and booking opportunities using AI-powered receptionist technology.



We are currently building our outbound sales team and are looking for an experienced B2B appointment setter who is confident speaking with business owners and decision-makers.



This is a sales position, not a basic virtual assistant or data-entry role.



You will be responsible for starting conversations with med spa owners, identifying potential problems around missed or unanswered calls, handling objections, and booking qualified appointments for our closer.



You will not be responsible for closing the final sale.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

Your main responsibility is to generate qualified sales appointments through outbound calling.



You will:

• Make outbound cold calls to med spas

• Speak with business owners and decision-makers

• Navigate receptionists and gatekeepers

• Identify potential pain around missed or unanswered calls

• Create interest in Velo Systems

• Handle common objections

• Lightly qualify prospects

• Book qualified appointments

• Follow up with interested prospects

• Confirm appointments

• Keep the CRM updated

• Maintain consistent daily activity



The sales process is simple:

Cold call → Conversation → Light qualification → Appointment → Closer



Our closer handles the deeper discovery, demonstration, pricing, objections, and closing.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Required

• 2+ years of proven B2B cold calling or appointment-setting experience

• Strong spoken English

• Confident and professional phone presence

• Experience speaking with business owners or decision-makers

• Strong objection-handling ability

• Ability to have natural conversations instead of simply reading a script

• Strong follow-up habits

• Reliable internet connection

• Quiet workspace

• Ability to consistently work 9 AM - 5 PM Eastern Time



Experience selling marketing services, SaaS, AI, agency services, healthcare, med spa services, or other B2B services is a strong advantage.



We care more about what you have actually produced than how impressive your resume sounds.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

You should be comfortable hearing:

• "Not interested."

• "Just send me an
."

• "We already have a receptionist."

• "How much does it cost?"

• "I'm too busy."

• "Call me later."



You should be able to stay calm, think on your feet, and keep the conversation moving without becoming overly aggressive or pushy.



You should also know when a prospect is not a good fit.



We care about qualified appointments, not simply filling the calendar.



DAILY ACTIVITY

Our initial target is approximately:

100 to 150 outbound attempts per day



This is not a competition to make meaningless calls.



We care about the entire funnel:

Calls → Conversations → Decision-makers → Qualified prospects → Appointments → Shows → Clients



A setter who makes 150 poor calls is not more valuable than someone who makes 100 high-quality calls and consistently produces qualified opportunities.



COMPENSATION

$500 USD/month base



Plus:

• Uncapped performance bonuses



Performance bonuses are tied to qualified appointments that attend and clients generated from your appointments.



There is no ceiling on performance earnings.



The exact bonus structure will be explained during the interview.



Our goal is to reward people who actually produce results.



TRAINING

You will not simply receive a phone number and be told to start dialing.



Before working with live leads, you will receive training on:

• Velo Systems

• Our AI receptionist solution

• Our target market

• Cold-call structure

• Receptionist and gatekeeper handling

• Qualification

• Objection handling

• Appointment booking

• Calendly

• CRM usage

• Follow-up

• Appointment confirmation



You will also complete roleplay before beginning live outbound.



HOW WE MEASURE PERFORMANCE

We track the entire sales funnel:

Outbound Attempts

↓

Connections

↓

Decision-Maker Conversations

↓

Qualified Prospects

↓

Appointments Booked

↓

Appointments Showed

↓

Closed Clients



We use these numbers to identify where the sales process can be improved.



You will also receive coaching based on actual recorded calls.



LONG-TERM OPPORTUNITY

We are looking for someone who wants to build a long-term position with the company.



As the sales operation grows, there will be opportunities for increased earning potential and additional responsibility for strong performers.



APPLICATION PROCESS

Please answer every question below.



Incomplete applications will not be considered.



1. How many years of B2B cold-calling experience do you have?

2. How many years of appointment-setting experience do you have?

3. What industries or types of businesses have you previously called?

4. Were your leads primarily cold, warm, inbound, or a mixture?

Please explain.

5. Approximately how many outbound calls did you make per day in your previous role?

6. Approximately how many qualified appointments did you generate per week or month?

7. What was your approximate appointment show rate?

If you don't know, just say so.

8. Who were you typically calling?

For example:

• Business owners

• CEOs

• Managers

• Receptionists

• Consumers

9. What countries were you calling?

10. What was the most difficult objection you regularly encountered, and how did you handle it?



ROLEPLAY QUESTION 1

Imagine you're calling a med spa owner.

They say:

"We already have a receptionist. We're not interested in an AI receptionist."

What would you say?

Write your response exactly as you would say it on the phone.



ROLEPLAY QUESTION 2

The owner says:

"Just send me an
."

What would you say?



VOICE RECORDING

Please provide a 60 to 90 second voice recording introducing yourself.



Tell us:

• Your sales experience

• Your cold-calling experience

• What type of businesses you've called

• Why you believe you'd be a strong fit for this position



We want to hear your natural speaking voice, confidence, communication style, and professionalism.



WORK SETUP

Please confirm that you have:

• Reliable computer

• Reliable high-speed internet

• Quality headset/microphone

• Quiet workspace

• Ability to work 9 AM - 5 PM Eastern Time



ATTENTION TO DETAIL

At the very end of your application, include:

VELO SALES



This lets us know that you read the entire job post.

title: AI Video Editor
description:
Velantra makes considered leather goods for women who value quality over noise. Our marketing lives on short-form video, and we're leaning heavily into AI-generated UGC — content that looks and feels like a real person filmed it on their phone, not like an ad. We're bringing on a video editor who can own production end to end and consistently turn out content that's indistinguishable from the real thing.



What You'll Do



You'll own our AI UGC pipeline from concept to finished cut. Day to day, that means:



Producing hyperrealistic AI UGC videos that look and feel natural — the kind of content people don't realize is AI

Working fluently across our core tools: HeyGen (avatars / talking heads), Google Flow (video generation), Seedance 2 (video generation), and ElevenLabs (voice). You'll have full access to all of our tools

Replicating the style of reference videos we give you 1:1 — matching pacing, framing, motion, lighting, and feel so closely that the output is indistinguishable from the reference

Getting the details right that make AI content believable: natural lighting, realistic motion, lip-sync accuracy, believable voice pacing, and clean audio

Editing raw AI-generated clips into polished, native-feeling short-form videos for Instagram, TikTok, and paid ads

Iterating quickly on feedback and turning around revisions without losing quality

Keeping an organized library of assets, footage, and final exports

What You'll Produce



Your weekly target is 15 finished concepts per week, across a mix of formats:



Short POV-style videos — roughly 10 seconds each

AI UGC greenscreen videos — 35–45 seconds each

Voiceover videos — 35–45 seconds each



For each concept, we'll typically provide a reference video, and your job is to replicate its style 1:1 while adapting it to our product. Consistency, speed, and a believable natural feel matter more than fancy effects.



What We're Looking For

Hands-on experience with HeyGen, Google Flow, Seedance 2, and ElevenLabs. This is a hard requirement — you should already know how to get high-quality output from these tools

A strong eye for what makes AI content look real vs. fake, and the skill to close that gap

The ability to study a reference video and reproduce its style precisely — pacing, framing, motion, and feel

Comfort working at volume and consistently hitting a weekly output target without cutting corners on quality

Solid short-form video editing skills (CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or similar)

An understanding of the UGC aesthetic — content that feels authentic and unpolished, not like a corporate ad

Fast, reliable, and able to manage your own production schedule without being micromanaged

A stable internet connection and a computer that can handle video work

Nice to Have

Experience creating content for a fashion, beauty, or accessories brand

Familiarity with paid social ad formats and what drives performance

Your own workflow or system for producing AI video efficiently at volume

Hours & Pay



This is a full-time role, 40 hours/week, Monday through Friday. We're flexible on your exact hours as long as there's some daily overlap with U.S. Pacific business hours. Pay starts at $500/month, and we're happy to revisit compensation as you take on more and prove yourself.



How to Apply



Please send a short message that includes:



A quick intro to your AI video experience and the tools you use

A portfolio, reel, or 2–3 example videos you've made using HeyGen, Google Flow, Seedance 2, or ElevenLabs — this is the most important part of your application

title: AI Video Editor for Fashion Brand
description:
Job Title: AI Video Editor for Fashion Brand (Full Time, $1,500/mo)

Type of Work: Full Time

Salary: $1,500 USD / month

Hours per Week: 40

Job Category: Video Editing / Multimedia

About the role

We are a fast-growing DTC fashion brand and we run paid social at volume. We are hiring a full-time video editor who lives in AI tooling and can turn a brief plus a reference ad into a finished, scroll-stopping video.

This is a real editing job, not a "learn AI on the job" job. Almost everything we ship is AI-generated: AI avatars, AI voiceover, AI b-roll, AI product motion. You will be handed a script, a reference ad, and product references, and you are expected to come back with an ad that holds attention from second one to the last frame.

Every AI tool is provided and paid for by us. You never pay for a credit.

What you'll do

Ship around 5 net new concepts per day for TikTok, Meta, and YouTube Shorts, working from scripts and briefs we give you. These are short: most land between 10 and 35 seconds

Generate assets with AI tools: avatars, voiceover, b-roll, product motion, lip sync

Replicate references. When we send a reference ad plus a brief, you match its pacing, structure, and energy for our product without copying it frame for frame

Cut for retention: strong first 2 seconds, tight pacing, no dead air, a visual change every few seconds

Build hooks that stop the scroll, both the visual and the on-screen text

Add captions, sound design, music, and text overlays that feel native to the platform

Iterate fast on feedback and keep files organized so the team can find anything

What the work is actually like

The generation itself is fast and cheap. Our tools do the heavy lifting, the prompts and workflows are already built, and the briefs are detailed. The work is simple and repeatable once you know the system. What we are paying for is speed, taste, and consistency: hitting the daily count without the quality sliding, and knowing which cut holds a viewer and which one loses them.

You're a good fit if

You are extremely comfortable with AI creative tools

You can execute across multiple formats and styles

You understand pacing, hooks, visual storytelling, and direct-response editing

You can take a reference and recreate the format without needing your hand held

You are FAST and can handle consistent creative volume

That last one matters most. Around 5 finished concepts per day is the standard here. The work itself is simple once you know the system, but you have to be able to hold the pace without the quality sliding.

Requirements

2 to 3 years minimum of professional video editing experience (Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, DaVinci, or equivalent)

Hands-on experience with AI video and audio tools. We use HeyGen, ElevenLabs, Veo 3, Google Omni, and Seedance 2. You should already be working in several of these, and you should be able to pick up the rest quickly

You have edited AI-generated assets for a fashion or apparel brand before. This is required, not a bonus. Fashion has a specific look, and generic AI product video does not sell handbags

Direct-response instinct. You know why a viewer drops off at 3 seconds and you know how to fix it. Most of our ads are 10 to 35 seconds, so every single second has to earn its place

You can build a hook, not just execute one someone handed you

Comfortable working inside a team with daily communication, shared feedback, and revision rounds

Reliable full-time availability and strong written English

Bonus points

You have edited creatives that have spent serious money on Meta or TikTok. If you have, tell us the spend level and what the ad was

$1,500 USD per month, full time, long term

The associate will be measured on completed tours, successful resident move-ins, follow-up effectiveness, and overall sales conversion performance.



## Key Responsibilities



### 1. Inbound Sales Calls & Tour Conversion



- Professionally answer incoming telephone inquiries from prospective residents, family members, and referral sources.

- Establish immediate rapport and build trust with callers.

- Ask effective discovery questions to understand care needs, financial considerations, urgency, preferred location, and decision-making factors.

- Clearly communicate the benefits and unique advantages of Gardens Care assisted living and memory care communities.

- Use proven consultative sales techniques to motivate families to schedule tours.

- Confidently overcome objections related to pricing, timing, location, and competing communities.

- Create appropriate urgency while remaining compassionate and professional.

- Actively ask for the appointment and secure a confirmed tour date and time.

- Maintain a minimum 75% qualified inbound call-to-tour conversion rate.



### 2. Outbound Sales Calls & Lead Follow-Up



- Proactively contact new inquiries, referral agency leads, and prospective families.

- Respond to new sales inquiries within five minutes during assigned working hours.

- Make consistent outbound calls to prospects who have not yet scheduled tours.

- Follow up through telephone calls,
s, and text messages.

- Reengage older leads and families who previously expressed interest.

- Use effective sales techniques to overcome objections and advance prospects through the sales process.

- Prioritize high-intent leads and families with immediate placement needs.

- Maintain a structured follow-up system to ensure no qualified lead is overlooked.



### 3. Tour Scheduling & Coordination



- Schedule tours at the appropriate Gardens Care community based on each family's needs and preferences.

- Coordinate tour appointments with community Executive Directors and sales representatives.

- Send appointment confirmations, reminders, community addresses, and directions.

- Communicate relevant prospect information to community staff before each tour.

- Follow up with families who cancel or miss appointments to reschedule.

- Track scheduled tours, completed tours, and attendance rates.

- Work toward achieving a minimum 85% scheduled-tour attendance rate.



### 4. Post-Tour Sales & Move-In Conversion



- Contact prospective families within 24 hours after completing a community tour.

- Gather feedback and identify concerns or objections preventing families from moving forward.

- Maintain consistent communication with families throughout the decision-making process.

- Build trust and demonstrate the value of Gardens Care's personalized approach to senior living.

- Encourage timely decisions through professional and ethical sales techniques.

- Coordinate with community leadership to address pricing, availability, and care-related questions.

- Explain the admissions process, required documentation, deposits, and move-in timelines.

- Assist families with completing admission paperwork and outstanding requirements.

- Follow up on pending commitments and help expedite resident move-ins.

- Coordinate with community staff to ensure a smooth transition from initial inquiry through move-in.



### 5. CRM Management & Organization



- Manage assigned leads and sales opportunities using **GoHighLevel (GHL)**.

- Accurately document meaningful telephone calls,
s, text messages, appointments, and follow-up activities.

- Maintain accurate sales pipeline stages and opportunity statuses.

- Create and manage daily follow-up tasks and reminders.

- Track lead sources, scheduled tours, completed tours, resident commitments, and successful move-ins.

- Identify stalled opportunities and proactively reengage prospective families.

- Ensure every active prospect has a documented next step and follow-up date.

- Prepare daily sales activity reports and weekly performance summaries.



### 6. Communication & Team Collaboration



- Communicate regularly with community Executive Directors and Gardens Care sales leadership.

- Notify appropriate staff when tours are scheduled or families are ready to commit.

- Coordinate admissions requirements with community personnel.

- Escalate clinical questions, pricing exceptions, and care-related concerns to authorized management.

- Maintain confidentiality of prospective resident and family information.

- Represent Gardens Care professionally, compassionately, and enthusiastically.



## Required Qualifications



- Must reside in the Philippines and be available to work U.S. business hours.

- **Exceptional spoken and written English with near-native fluency is mandatory.**

- Clear, confident, polished, and professional telephone communication skills.

- Minimum two years of successful experience in inside sales, telephone sales, or appointment setting.

- Proven ability to convert telephone inquiries into scheduled appointments.

- Strong consultative selling, objection-handling, relationship-building, and closing skills.

- Outstanding organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Ability to manage multiple leads, appointments, and follow-up schedules simultaneously.

- Experience with CRM software; GoHighLevel preferred.

- Strong computer proficiency, including
, spreadsheets, calendars, and online communication platforms.

- Self-motivated, dependable, accountable, and capable of working independently.

- Reliable high-speed internet, professional headset, and quiet home office.



## Preferred Qualifications



- Previous sales experience in assisted living, memory care, senior living, healthcare, or related industries.

- Experience communicating with U.S.-based customers.

- Familiarity with American culture and customer service expectations.

- Experience using GoHighLevel sales pipelines, workflows, and reporting.

- Demonstrated success meeting aggressive sales conversion targets.

- Experience helping customers navigate complex purchasing or enrollment decisions.



## Performance Standards & Key Performance Indicators



Performance will be evaluated based on measurable sales results, consistent follow-up, and accurate CRM management.



| Performance Metric                        | Required Standard            |

| ----------------------------------------- | ---------------------------- |

| Qualified inbound call-to-tour conversion | **Minimum 75%**              |

| Preferred call-to-tour conversion         | **85% or higher**            |

| New lead response time                    | Within 5 minutes             |

| Tour confirmations                        | 100%                         |

| Scheduled-tour attendance rate            | Target 85% or higher         |

| Post-tour family follow-up                | Within 24 hours              |

| Active lead follow-up compliance          | 100%                         |

| CRM documentation                         | 100%                         |

| Daily sales activity report               | Required                     |

| Move-in support                           | Through successful admission |



**Call-to-Tour Conversion Definition:** Conversion is calculated using qualified, unique inbound sales inquiries and confirmed tour appointments. Duplicate calls, vendor inquiries, existing-resident service calls, and unrelated inquiries are excluded.



## Performance-Based Compensation & Bonus Structure



Gardens Care offers performance-based sales incentives designed to reward successful tour attendance, resident move-ins, and achievement of monthly sales conversion goals.



### Monthly Bonus Schedule



| Performance Achievement                          | Bonus Amount (USD) |

| ------------------------------------------------ | ------------------ |

| Each qualified, completed community tour         | **$10.00**         |

| Each successful resident move-in                 | **$25.00**         |

| Monthly call-to-tour conversion of 75%–84.99%    | **$100.00**        |

| Monthly call-to-tour conversion of 85% or higher | **$200.00**        |



### Bonus Eligibility Requirements



**1. Completed Community Tour Bonus – $10.00**



- The prospective resident or family must physically attend a scheduled community tour.

- The associate must have been responsible for securing or scheduling the tour.

- The completed tour must be documented in GoHighLevel.

- Cancelled appointments, no-shows, and duplicate tours do not qualify.



**2. Successful Resident Move-In Bonus – $25.00**



- The prospective resident must successfully move into a Gardens Care community.

- The associate must have actively participated in the sales process through lead management, tour scheduling, or post-tour follow-up.

- The move-in must be confirmed by community management and documented in GoHighLevel.



**3. Monthly Call-to-Tour Conversion Bonus**



- Achieving a monthly qualified call-to-tour conversion rate of **75%–84.99% earns $100.00**.

- Achieving a monthly qualified call-to-tour conversion rate of **85% or higher earns $200.00**.

- Monthly conversion bonuses are not cumulative. Only the highest qualifying monthly conversion bonus is awarded.

- Conversion rates will be calculated using qualified, unique inbound sales inquiries and confirmed scheduled tours.

- Duplicate calls, unrelated inquiries, vendors, and existing-resident service calls are excluded.

- A minimum qualified monthly lead volume may be established by management.



### Example Monthly Performance Bonuses



The following example illustrates potential monthly bonus earnings based on successful sales performance.



| Monthly Sales Achievement              | Bonus Amount  |

| -------------------------------------- | ------------- |

| 40 completed community tours × $10     | $400.00       |

| 25 successful resident move-ins × $25  | $625.00       |

| Monthly call-to-tour conversion of 80% | $100.00       |

| **Total Monthly Performance Bonuses**  | **$1,125.00** |



**Higher Performance Example**



If the associate achieves the same 40 completed tours and 25 successful move-ins while maintaining an 85% or higher call-to-tour conversion rate:



| Monthly Sales Achievement                        | Bonus Amount  |

| ------------------------------------------------ | ------------- |

| 40 completed community tours × $10               | $400.00       |

| 25 successful resident move-ins × $25            | $625.00       |

| Monthly call-to-tour conversion of 85% or higher | $200.00       |

| **Total Monthly Performance Bonuses**            | **$1,225.00** |



Actual bonuses depend on verified sales performance and are not guaranteed.



Bonuses will be calculated monthly based on documented results in GoHighLevel and paid in accordance with Gardens Care payroll policies and applicable Philippine employment requirements.



## Characteristics of Our Ideal Candidate



We are seeking an individual who is:



- **Sales-driven:** Confidently asks families to schedule tours and move forward.

- **Persuasive:** Communicates value effectively and knows how to overcome objections.

- **Compassionate:** Understands the emotional challenges families face when selecting senior living.

- **Exceptionally organized:** Never misses important follow-ups or sales opportunities.

- **Persistent:** Maintains consistent communication without becoming overly aggressive.

- **Results-focused:** Takes ownership of tour conversion rates, completed tours, and move-ins.

- **Proactive:** Identifies opportunities and takes initiative without constant supervision.

- **Accountable:** Understands that success is measured by meaningful sales results.



## Our Sales Philosophy



At Gardens Care Senior Living, every inquiry represents a family searching for guidance, reassurance, and quality care for someone they love.



Our Virtual Inside Sales Associate must do more than answer questions or schedule appointments. This individual must become a trusted resource who builds relationships, inspires confidence, motivates families to visit our communities, and actively guides them toward successful move-ins.



**Our goal is to turn inquiries into tours, tours into relationships, and relationships into successful resident move-ins.**



*Plant Effort. Grow Excellence.*

  



Screener to apply: 



 Your Assignment:

Imagine you are a Gardens Care Senior Living Sales Associate, and I am a daughter searching for assisted living for my 85-year-old mother.

My mother is currently living alone, and I am becoming concerned about her safety, medication management, and increasing need for assistance. I have been researching several assisted living communities but have not yet d
 which one to visit.

You called me to discuss Gardens Care Senior Living, but I did not answer.

Your task is to call me at 
and leave me a voi
 convincing me to schedule a tour of Gardens Care Senior Living.

Instructions

Leave a professional voi
 lasting approximately 45–60 seconds.

Introduce yourself as a Gardens Care Senior Living Sales Associate.

Demonstrate excellent English pronunciation, grammar, and conversational fluency.

Explain why visiting Gardens Care would be valuable to my family.

Use effective sales techniques to motivate me to schedule a tour.

End with a confident, compelling call to action that encourages me to return your call and schedule an appointment.

Important: Do not simply ask me to call you back. Your objective is to make me genuinely interested in touring Gardens Care Senior Living.

You may prepare your message in advance, but it should sound natural, confident, warm, and conversational—not like you are reading a script.

How We Will Evaluate Your Voi

We will evaluate your performance based on:

English fluency and clarity: Clear pronunciation, professional grammar, and natural communication.

Sales ability: Your ability to create interest, communicate value, and motivate action.

Confidence and enthusiasm: A professional, engaging telephone presence.

Empathy: Your ability to connect with a family facing an important senior care decision.

Closing technique: A strong, persuasive invitation to schedule a community tour.

Professionalism: Organization, appropriate pacing, and overall message quality.

Application Requirement

Applicants who do not complete the telephone screening exercise will not be considered for the position.

We are seeking a sales professional who can turn telephone conversations into scheduled tours—not someone who simply answers calls.

Show us why you are the right person to represent Gardens Care Senior Living!

Plant Effort. Grow Excellence.

title: Experienced Meta Ads Media Buyer – E-commerce & Lead Generation (Part-Time, Remote)
description:
# Hiring: Meta Ads Media Buyer – E-commerce & Lead Generation (Part-Time, Remote)



**Job Type:** Part-Time, Long-Term

**Compensation:** US$6/hour

**Working Hours:** Approximately 10 hours per week initially, with opportunities for increased hours

**Schedule:** Flexible, with some availability for meetings during Eastern Time (Canada)



## About the Role



We are looking for an experienced, analytical, and results-driven **Meta Ads Media Buyer** to manage and optimize
 and Instagram advertising campaigns for businesses targeting the Canadian and North American markets.



Our initial focus is on an established Canadian e-commerce business specializing in premium baby gifts. Over the next 3–6 months, we plan to expand into lead generation campaigns for online coaches, consultants, and personal development businesses.



The ideal candidate has hands-on experience generating profitable e-commerce sales and qualified leads through Meta advertising.



We are looking for someone who can take ownership of campaign performance, proactively identify opportunities for improvement, and help us scale advertising profitably.



**This is a long-term opportunity for the right candidate to grow with us.**



## Key Responsibilities



### 1. Meta Ads Campaign Management



- Plan, set up, launch, manage, and optimize
 and Instagram advertising campaigns.

- Develop advertising strategies for e-commerce sales and lead generation.

- Research and test audiences, placements, campaign structures, and targeting approaches.

- Monitor campaign performance and make data-driven adjustments.

- Manage advertising budgets efficiently to maximize return on investment.

- Identify winning campaigns and implement strategies for profitable scaling.



### 2. Ad Creative Strategy & Testing



- Research competitors and identify successful advertising approaches.

- Develop compelling ad copy, headlines, and calls to action.

- Recommend effective creative concepts, including images, videos, and carousel ads.

- Conduct structured A/B testing of ad creatives, messaging, and offers.

- Analyze creative performance and recommend improvements.

- Work with existing brand assets and coordinate additional creative requirements with the business owner.



### 3. E-commerce Advertising



- Manage Meta Ads campaigns focused on generating online purchases.

- Optimize campaigns for ROAS, cost per purchase, and profitability.

- Identify potential audiences and effective advertising angles.

- Analyze the customer journey from ad click to purchase.

- Recommend strategies to improve conversion performance and scale successful campaigns.



### 4. Lead Generation Advertising



- Plan and manage lead generation campaigns for coaches, consultants, and online businesses.

- Develop advertising strategies for webinars, workshops, online courses, consultations, and other lead generation offers.

- Optimize campaigns for cost per lead (CPL), lead quality, and customer acquisition.

- Test different audiences, messaging, offers, and creative approaches.

- Collaborate with the business owner to improve funnel performance and lead conversion rates.



### 5. Tracking, Analytics & Optimization



- Set up, review, and troubleshoot Meta Pixel and conversion tracking.

- Understand Meta Conversions API (CAPI) and conversion event optimization.

- Track and analyze important metrics, including:

  - ROAS (Return on Ad Spend)

  - CPA (Cost per Acquisition)

  - CPL (Cost per Lead)

  - CTR (Click-Through Rate)

  - CPC (Cost per Click)

  - CPM (Cost per 1,000 Impressions)

  - Conversion rates

- Identify performance issues and recommend solutions.

- Make optimization decisions based on meaningful conversion data rather than vanity metrics.



### 6. Reporting & Communication



- Provide concise weekly performance reports covering campaign results, key metrics, and advertising spend.

- Clearly explain what is working, what is not, and what actions are being taken.

- Recommend new tests, budget adjustments, and growth opportunities.

- Communicate proactively about campaign performance and potential issues.

- Participate in occasional online meetings to review results and discuss strategy.



## Requirements



**Must Have:**



- Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience managing Meta Ads campaigns.

- Proven experience running successful Shopify or similar e-commerce advertising campaigns.

- Experience managing lead generation campaigns, preferably for coaches, consultants, online courses, or service-based businesses.

- Strong knowledge of Meta Ads Manager and conversion-focused advertising strategies.

- Demonstrated ability to optimize campaigns for ROAS, CPA, CPL, and profitability.

- Experience with audience research, creative testing, campaign optimization, and scaling.

- Familiarity with Meta Pixel, Conversions API, and conversion tracking.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

- Good written and spoken English.

- Ability to work independently, take initiative, and meet deadlines.

- Reliable internet connection and availability for regular communication.



**Nice to Have:**



- Experience targeting Canadian and US audiences.

- Experience advertising premium consumer products or gift-related products.

- Experience promoting webinars, workshops, and coaching programs.

- Basic Canva or video editing skills for adapting existing advertising creatives.

- Familiarity with Shopify Analytics and Google Analytics 4 (GA4).

- Experience managing multiple advertising accounts.



**Please Note:** Visuals, landing page development, CRM management, and
/SMS automations are NOT required for this role. These will be handled separately. Your primary focus will be Meta advertising performance.



## What We Offer



- **US$6/hour**, paid based on hours worked.

- Approximately 10 hours per week initially.

- Flexible working schedule.

- Fully remote position.

- Long-term opportunity with the potential for increased hours and responsibilities.

- Opportunity to work on both e-commerce and coaching/lead generation campaigns.

- Direct communication and collaboration with the business owner.

- Existing marketing assets, product images, and brand materials to support advertising campaigns.

- Opportunity to contribute ideas, develop advertising strategies, and grow professionally.



## How to Apply



To be considered, please answer the following questions in your application:



**1. Meta Ads Experience**



How many years have you been managing Meta Ads campaigns? Briefly describe the types of businesses you have worked with.



**2. E-commerce Results**



Share an example of a successful Shopify or e-commerce Meta Ads campaign you personally managed.



Please include:



- Monthly advertising spend

- Product or industry

- ROAS achieved

- Cost per purchase (CPA)

- Your role in achieving the results



**3. Lead Generation Experience**



Have you managed Meta Ads for coaches, consultants, webinars, online courses, or other lead generation businesses?



If yes, please provide an example, including advertising spend, CPL, and lead quality or conversion results.



**4. Campaign Strategy**



If you were given a monthly Meta Ads budget of C$2,000 for a Canadian e-commerce brand, how would you approach the first 30 days?



Please provide a brief overview of your strategy.



**5. Availability & Compensation**



Are you comfortable working approximately 10 hours per week at US$6/hour? Are you available for weekly meetings during Canadian Eastern Time?



**6. Portfolio**



Please share relevant case studies, campaign screenshots, or examples of advertising accounts you have managed. You may hide confidential client information.



### Important



We are looking for a **performance-focused media buyer**, not a general social media manager or someone whose primary experience is boosting
 posts.



You should be comfortable taking ownership of Meta Ads campaigns, analyzing results, proposing improvements, and working toward profitable growth.



Shortlisted candidates may be invited to complete a small paid practical assessment.



**To confirm you have read this entire posting, please start your application with the words "Meta Growth".**



We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Part-Time Automotive Call Center Representative
description:
Part-Time Automotive Call Center Representative - ****ONLY APPOINTMENT SETTERS NEED APPLY******



Remote | U.S. Central Time Hours | Automotive Appointment Setting



POSITION OVERVIEW



We are looking for a dependable, professional, and personable Part-Time Call Center Representative to join our automotive marketing team.



Our company works with automotive dealerships throughout the United States. Your primary responsibility will be speaking with customers and setting appointments for participating dealerships.



This is a long-term, remote, work-from-home position requiring a commitment of approximately 2–3 hours per day during U.S. Central Time (CST) hours.



Spanish-speaking applicants are strongly encouraged to apply and receive higher compensation.



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES



Make and/or receive calls related to automotive dealership campaigns



Speak professionally and confidently with customers



Follow company-provided call scripts and procedures



Answer basic customer questions using provided campaign information



Encourage customers to schedule dealership appointments



Accurately schedule appointments



Enter customer information and call results into our CRM



Document calls accurately



Follow up with customers when required



Maintain a friendly and professional attitude on every call



The primary objective of this position is simple:



Provide excellent customer service while converting customer interest into dealership appointments.



SCHEDULE & TIME COMMITMENT



This is a part-time position requiring approximately 2–3 hours per day, Monday through Friday.



Hours will fall within U.S. Central Time (CST) business hours.



Depending on business and campaign needs, your daily hours may be:



Worked together in one block, OR



Spread throughout the day



Some weeks may require the hours to be distributed differently based on call volume and campaign needs.



Saturday Availability



Occasionally, approximately 1 hour on Saturday may be required when needed.



Saturday work is not necessarily required every week.



Flexibility, reliability, and punctuality are important for this position.



COMPENSATION



English-Speaking Call Center Representative



$250 USD per month



Bilingual English/Spanish Call Center Representative



$360 USD per month



To qualify for the bilingual compensation level, you must be able to comfortably and professionally communicate with customers in both English and Spanish over the telephone.



Spanish proficiency may be verified during the interview process.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We want someone who is:



Comfortable speaking with customers on the telephone



Friendly and personable



Confident and professional



Able to build rapport quickly



Able to follow a script without sounding like they are reading



Comfortable asking customers for the appointment



Persistent without being overly aggressive



A good listener



Able to think and respond appropriately during live conversations



Reliable and punctual



Detail-oriented



Comfortable using a computer and CRM



Able to work independently from home



Coachable and willing to improve



Previous experience in call centers, appointment setting, customer service, automotive BDC, telemarketing, or sales is preferred but not required.



We are willing to train the right person.



LANGUAGE REQUIREMENTS



Strong spoken English is REQUIRED.



You must be able to communicate clearly and professionally with U.S.-based customers.



Spanish



Spanish is a PLUS and receives higher compensation.



Applicants applying for the bilingual position should be comfortable carrying on a complete customer conversation in Spanish—not simply speaking basic or conversational Spanish.



WORK-FROM-HOME REQUIREMENTS



You must have:



Reliable high-speed internet



Reliable computer



Quality headset with microphone



Quiet work environment



Minimal background noise during customer calls



Ability to consistently work your assigned hours



TRAINING



Training will be provided on:



Automotive campaigns



Call scripts



Appointment-setting procedures



CRM usage



Customer handling



Call documentation



Appointment expectations



We provide the systems, scripts, and procedures. We expect the successful candidate to learn quickly, accept coaching, and consistently apply what they have been taught.



HOW TO APPLY



Please include:



A brief introduction about yourself.



Your previous call center, customer-service, appointment-setting, automotive, BDC, telemarketing, or sales experience.



Your level of spoken English.



Whether you speak Spanish and your level of Spanish proficiency.



Confirmation that you can commit to approximately 2–3 hours per day during U.S. Central Time hours.



Confirmation that you understand the hours may sometimes be worked in one block or spread throughout the day.



Confirmation that you can occasionally work approximately 1 hour on Saturday when needed.



Applicants selected for the next stage may be asked to provide a short voice recording and participate in a live interview.



We are looking for someone interested in a stable, long-term part-time position who will take their schedule and responsibilities seriously.

title: Assistant for US Law Firm
description:
CASE ASSISTANT – US CRIMINAL DEFENSE LAW FIRM

Discovery Preparation - Client Communication - Call Routing - Administrative Support

Full-Time | Remote



ABOUT US

We are launching What Changed Us, an original cinematic storytelling channel on YouTube featuring emotionally powerful films about love, family, sacrifice, unexpected relationships, betrayal, redemption, and the moments that change people's lives.



Our goal is to produce beautiful, realistic, emotionally compelling movies—not generic AI slideshows, animated photo sequences, or narrated stock footage.



Our first original film, The Woman Who Raised My Sons, explores extraordinary love, family, sacrifice, and the meaning of motherhood.

- Transform original stories and screenplays into cinematic films.

- Direct believable human performances with expressive emotions and natural movements.

- Maintain consistent character faces, appearances, voices, and environments across scenes.

- Develop compelling cinematography, camera movements, lighting, and scene transitions.

- Handle AI scene generation, editing, pacing, and final production.

- Collaborate with the story creator while respecting the original artistic vision.



Experience with AI filmmaking tools and professional editing software is important. Demonstrated cinematic storytelling ability matters more than any particular software.



Production Budget and Expectations

We envision approximately 35–45 minutes for our first movie, but we're open to recommendations regarding realistic production length and quality within our budget.



We want you to tell us what you can deliver.



Rather than automatically selecting the lowest bid, we will evaluate production quality, storytelling ability, artistic direction, proposed runtime, and overall value.



Proposals should identify what is included in the fixed project price, including AI generation costs, voices, music, editing, revisions, and final deliverables.



Our intention is to build a lasting production relationship. As the channel grows and earns audience engagement, opportunities for larger production budgets may become available.



How to Apply

3. The AI filmmaking and editing tools you use.

5. Your proposed film length, deliverables, estimated production schedule, and fixed-price quote within our $1,500–$3,000 budget.

Shortlisted filmmakers may be invited to complete a separate, agreed fixed-price paid cinematic evaluation before any full-film contract is offered.



Please begin your application with the words "Every Person Has a Story" so we know you've read the complete posting.



We welcome emerging filmmakers as well as experienced creative directors. What matters most is your ability to tell a story that moves people.



We look forward to discovering our next creative filmmaking partner.



What Changed Us



The moments that change everything.

title: B2B Appointment Setter / SDR – Warm Leads
description:
Appointment Setter / SDR – $750/Month + Performance Bonuses



Apply Here



To be considered, complete our short application form:





You will be asked to upload a 60–90 second introduction video explaining your experience and why you are suitable for the role.



Applications without a completed Typeform and introduction video will not be considered.



About the Role



We are looking for a reliable, confident and highly organised Appointment Setter / SDR to join our team long-term.

We operate a B2B client-acquisition company working with established professional-service businesses, primarily Accounting and Tax firms in the United States.



Our outbound campaigns generate interested prospects. Your job is not to hard-sell accounting services.



Your job is to contact interested prospects, qualify them, book them onto our clients’ calendars, confirm their appointments and help ensure they attend.



Compensation



$750 USD per month base salary



Plus:



$3 USD for every qualified appointment that shows up



Bonuses are based on attended appointments—not simply appointments booked.



There is room for increased compensation and responsibility for strong performers.



Your Responsibilities



You will manage prospects from the moment they express interest until they attend an appointment.



This includes:



Calling new leads as quickly as possible

Following up by phone,
 and SMS

Contacting interested prospects who have not booked

Asking basic qualification questions

Booking suitable prospects onto client calendars

Calling direct bookings to confirm and qualify them

Reconfirming upcoming appointments

Following up with no-shows

Rescheduling missed appointments

Following up with older opportunities

Updating CRM stages and notes

Keeping client calendars organised

Informing clients which appointments are confirmed

Following our scripts, SOPs and follow-up processes



Your goal is simple:



The client should only need to open Zoom and speak with a qualified prospect who is prepared for the conversation.



What You Are Not Doing



You are not expected to:



Close the final sale

Give detailed accounting or tax advice

Pressure prospects into purchasing

Make completely unqualified calls all day

Your job is to sell the meeting, not the service.



You should be able to explain why the consultation may be worthwhile, answer basic questions, qualify the prospect and move them toward an appointment.



Typical Workflow



When a new interested prospect enters the CRM:

You receive a notification.

You check whether they have already booked.

If they have not booked, you contact them quickly.

You ask the required qualification questions.

If suitable, you book them onto the client’s calendar.

You add clear notes and update the CRM.

You reconfirm the appointment before the meeting.

If they do not attend, you follow up and reschedule them.

You continue following up according to our SOP.



You will regularly review the CRM for:



New leads

Leads requiring follow-up

Unbooked prospects

Upcoming appointments

Unconfirmed appointments

No-shows

Rescheduling opportunities



Requirements



You must have:



Excellent spoken English

Clear and easy-to-understand pronunciation

Strong conversational skills

Confidence speaking with American business owners

Appointment-setting, SDR, call-centre, sales or customer-service experience

Strong written English

Good organisation and attention to detail

Reliable high-speed internet

A reliable computer and headset

A quiet working environment

The ability to follow scripts and SOPs

The ability to maintain accurate CRM records

The ability to work independently



You do not need to imitate an American accent. However, your English must be clear, natural and professional.



Helpful Experience



Experience with any of the following is beneficial:

B2B appointment setting

SDR work

Cold calling

Warm or inbound lead follow-up

High-ticket appointment setting

Accounting or financial services

GoHighLevel

Smartlead

Slack

Calendly

Google Calendar

CRM management

US-based clients



Training will be provided on our systems and processes.



Working Hours



You will primarily contact prospects in the United States, so you must be comfortable working hours that overlap with US business hours.



For applicants in the Philippines, this will generally require evening or overnight work.



Your exact schedule may change depending on the clients assigned to you.



We care heavily about speed to lead. New prospects should be contacted quickly during your working hours.



How Performance Is Measured - Your performance will be measured using:



Speed to lead

Contact rate

Lead-to-appointment booking rate

Appointment confirmation rate

Show rate

Qualified attended appointments

Follow-up consistency

CRM accuracy

Call quality



We are not looking for someone who simply makes calls.



We want someone who takes ownership of the pipeline and thinks:



“How do I move as many suitable prospects as possible from interested lead, to booked appointment, to attended appointment?”



Training Provided - You will receive training covering:



Our appointment-setting process

Our clients’ services and offers

Basic Accounting and Tax terminology

Qualification questions

Common prospect questions

Appointment booking

CRM management

Direct bookings

Appointment confirmations

No-show recovery

Rescheduling

Long-term pipeline follow-up

Scripts and objection handling



You will receive clear SOPs and ongoing feedback.



Who We Want - We want someone who is:



Reliable

Confident on the phone

Friendly and professional

Coachable

Competitive

Detail-oriented

Consistent

Hungry to improve

Comfortable speaking with business owners

Capable of working without constant supervision



This is intended to be a long-term position.



As the company grows, there will be opportunities to manage more client accounts, earn additional bonuses and potentially progress into a senior setter or SDR management role.



Hiring Process



Complete the Typeform application.

Upload your 60–90 second introduction video.

Selected candidates will be invited to a group interview.

The final few candidates will complete a short call-script test.

The strongest candidate will attend a final interview and receive an offer.



How to Apply

Complete the application here:





Your introduction video should include:



Your name and location

Your relevant experience

The industries you have worked with

Whether the prospects were cold, warm or inbound

Why you believe you would succeed in this role



We are looking for someone who can learn our process, follow it consistently, communicate clearly and take responsibility for getting qualified prospects onto our clients’ calendars.



If you are confident on the phone, have excellent English and enjoy appointment setting, we would like to hear from you.
