title: Virtual Assistant — Social Media & Community
description:
About TaperClinic



TaperClinic is the world's premier psychiatric drug tapering program, founded by Dr. Josef Witt-Doerring, a board-certified psychiatrist and former FDA medical officer. We help people safely come off psychiatric medications and rebuild their health with a multidisciplinary team behind them. Our content, Dr. Josef's YouTube channel, Instagram, and other social platforms, reaches millions of people every month, many of whom are looking for answers they can't get anywhere else.



That audience is why this role exists. Every comment and DM is a person, often one in a hard season of their life, and how we respond is part of the care we provide.



Role Overview



We're looking for a self-sufficient, proactive virtual assistant to manage our social media community and support our content operations. You'll be the first touchpoint for the people who reach out to us every day, keep our comment sections healthy, and produce simple graphics and stories that match our brand.



This role starts at 10 hours per week with room to grow as you demonstrate ownership. We are specifically looking for a go-getter: someone who sees what needs doing and does it, flags problems before we find them, and doesn't need daily direction to deliver.



Responsibilities

Respond to comments and DMs across our platforms (Instagram, YouTube,
, X) in TaperClinic's voice, warm, clear, and on-message, using our response guidelines and templates.

Moderate comment sections: remove spam, hide abusive content, and keep discussions safe and respectful.

Escalate, never advise. Route medical questions to the clinic team and follow our crisis protocol immediately for any message suggesting someone may be in danger. You will never give medical advice, and we will train you on exactly what to say and who to alert.

Create Instagram stories and graphics from our templates and brand assets.

Build UTM links for campaigns and posts as needed so we can track what's working.

Flag recurring questions, notable comments, and content ideas from the community to the marketing team.

What Success Looks Like

Comments and DMs receive timely, on-brand responses, and nothing urgent slips through.

Our comment sections stay clean, safe, and welcoming.

Stories and graphics go out consistently and look like us.

Links are tagged correctly and the team trusts the tracking.

You've made this corner of the operation something we don't have to think about.

Qualifications

Excellent written English with a warm, professional tone.

Experience managing social media accounts, community inboxes, or online communities (personal or professional).

Basic design skills in Canva or similar; comfort working from templates.

Organized, reliable, and detail-oriented; comfortable with spreadsheets and link builders (we'll teach you our UTM conventions).

Sound judgment and discretion. Our DMs can include sensitive personal health information, and confidentiality is non-negotiable.

Emotional maturity for a mental health audience: patience with people who are struggling, and the judgment to know when something needs a human above your pay grade, fast.

Self-starter who works independently, meets deadlines, and communicates proactively.

Bonus: familiarity with the mental health space, ManyChat or similar DM automation, and basic video/Reels editing.

Compensation & Details

Rate: $5/hour

Hours: 10 hours per week to start, with growth potential based on performance

Location: Fully remote

Schedule: Flexible, but consistent daily coverage of comments/DMs is required

Type: Independent contractor (1099)

How to Apply



Send us: (1) a short note on why this role fits you, (2) links or screenshots of social accounts or graphics you've worked on, and (3) a sample reply to this DM: "I've been on antidepressants for 6 years and I want to get off. Can Dr. Josef help me?"

title: Steel Fabrication & Engineering Estimator
description:
Work From Home Senior Estimator – Steel Fabrication & Engineering







Location: Remote (Philippines)



Hours: Full-Time (40 hours per week)



Working Hours: Australian Business Hours



Experience: Minimum 2 years of Australian steel fabrication or engineering estimating experience







About the Opportunity



We are seeking an experienced Senior Estimator to join an established Australian engineering and steel fabrication business, supporting its existing estimating team and Project Managers.



This is a hands-on senior role for someone with strong experience in steel fabrication, structural steel, engineering projects, and commercial estimating. You will be responsible for preparing accurate and competitive estimates, reviewing technical drawings and specifications, assessing fabrication and project costs, and supporting the team throughout the tendering and project delivery process.



The ideal candidate is proactive, commercially minded, and comfortable collaborating remotely with an Australian team through daily online meetings, visual drawing reviews, and ongoing communication.



You will play an important role in strengthening the estimating team's capacity, improving estimating accuracy, and ensuring projects are priced accurately and delivered with a clear understanding of costs, scope, and risks.







Key Responsibilities







Senior Estimating & Steel Fabrication



Review tender documents, engineering drawings, technical specifications, and project requirements to establish scope and pricing requirements.

Prepare detailed estimates, quotations, and tender submissions for steel fabrication and multidisciplinary engineering projects.

Perform material take-offs and quantify structural steel, plates, pipes, fittings, fabricated components, and associated materials.

Estimate costs for fabrication, welding, cutting, forming, machining, assembly, surface treatment, painting, galvanising, delivery, and installation, where applicable.

Assess material grades, specifications, fabrication requirements, and project complexity to develop accurate cost estimates.

Obtain and evaluate supplier and subcontractor quotations, ensuring pricing reflects current costs, scope, and lead times.

Identify scope gaps, pricing risks, discrepancies, exclusions, and potential cost overruns before submitting tenders.

Review drawing revisions and variations, updating estimates and quotations to reflect changes in project scope.





Engineering & Technical Estimating







Interpret structural, mechanical, fabrication, and engineering drawings to determine quantities, specifications, and fabrication requirements.

Review fabrication drawings, piping layouts, isometric drawings, and technical documentation where applicable.

Assess estimating requirements for structural steelwork, plate fabrication, tanks, vessels, piping and spooling, pump skids, and mining-related equipment such as chutes and hoppers.

Consider material requirements, fabrication methods, welding specifications, quality requirements, and applicable project standards.

Coordinate with engineering and detailing teams to clarify technical information, resolve discrepancies, and confirm scope.

Identify opportunities to improve fabrication efficiency, material utilisation, and overall project cost without compromising quality or specifications.

The project scope may include mining, oil and gas, energy, utilities, and commercial or residential construction projects, depending on client requirements.







Proactive Estimating Team Collaboration







Work closely with the existing estimating team through daily online communication, visual collaboration, and virtual meetings.

Participate in live drawing reviews, estimate walkthroughs, tender discussions, and technical clarification sessions.

Proactively communicate estimating progress, outstanding information, pricing concerns, and potential project risks.

Collaborate with team members to review quantities, cost breakdowns, supplier pricing, and tender assumptions.

Take ownership of assigned estimates while ensuring the wider team has visibility of progress and deadlines.

Raise questions and escalate issues early rather than waiting for instructions or allowing delays to affect submissions.

Maintain clear, professional, and timely communication with Australian colleagues during Australian business hours.

title: Part-Time Real Estate & Property Management Virtual Assistant

title: AI Image Specialist (Photorealistic Frames + Prompt Improvement)
description:
Description:



I make content with AI characters and need someone who is truly advanced at photorealistic AI images. I’ll send you my prompts. Your job is to make them better, deliver images that look like real phone photos, and teach me how you do it.



What you’ll do:



Take my prompts and fix them however needed to get the best possible result

Create the images in Nano Banana Pro (Gemini), GPT Image or whatever tool gets the best quality

Make sure every frame works well as a starting frame for AI video in Google Flow / Omni

Help write and improve the motion prompts for each frame

Keep the same character, outfit and location consistent across every image in a set

Catch and fix every flaw before sending: hands, faces, props, text, lighting, plastic skin

Tell me what you changed and why, so I can improve my prompt system (I want to learn too!)

Suggest better methods, tools or workflows when you see them

Deliver through Google Drive, named and in order



Must have:



A portfolio of photorealistic AI images that pass as real photos

Proven character consistency across many images

Deep knowledge of prompting: you understand WHY an image fails and how to fix it, not just retrying until it works

Clear written English to explain your changes

Weekday availability and reliable internet



Big plus:



Experience with pet content: realistic dogs with correct breed features, natural fur, believable interaction with people

Experience with skincare/beauty content: realistic skin texture, clean product shots with correct labels and packaging

Experience turning images into AI video (Omni / Veo)



Pay and workload:



This starts as a part-time with the plan to bring you on full time as we scale

Usually 2 image sets per day, sometimes 3 to 4

Around 15 to 20+ images per set

$3 per finished and approved set, paid weekly

Every set is reviewed and approved by me before it counts

If you’re a pro, this shouldn’t take you long



How to apply:



Send 5 to 10 images of the SAME character in different settings. Bonus if you include pet or skincare work. Best work only

If you have any AI video made from your images, send that too

In 2 to 3 sentences, tell me the most common reason AI images look fake and how you fix it

Start your application with the word “FRAMES”

**must do this or you wont be considered**



Shortlisted applicants get a paid test using one of my real prompts. Quality d
 the hire.

title: Video Editor — Art Channel (Premiere Pro, ongoing)
description:
Stable, recurring part-time video editing work for an art YouTube channel + social media. We make multicam painting process tutorials: satisfying, color-rich, music-synced. Hiring one editor, long-term.

Scope of work

Work is paid per project. One project is the full set of deliverables cut from a single filmed painting tutorial:

• 1 long-form YouTube edit ~10–15 min, from pre-synced multicam footage

• 2
 
 — 3–5 min, reframed to square

• 4 vertical Shorts/Reels

Rate is agreed per project and discussed with shortlisted applicants. Volume is currently around two projects a month, with room to grow.

Turnaround: long-form first cut within 5 business days; Shorts and cutdowns within 3 days.

Revisions: 3 consolidated rounds per deliverable included.

Required

• 3+ years editing professionally

• Expert-level Premiere Pro (not Final Cut, not DaVinci, not CapCut)

• Strong color grading

• Strong spoken and written English — we use
 for day-to-day messaging and have live calls when needed

• Google Drive

The style

Process videos (painting tutorial), no talking head. The artist is the subject, and the painting process is the focus.

• Satisfying and dynamic — the painting has rhythm. Pacing that breathes: fast when the pour demands it, slow when the detail does.

• Color-led — consistent grading across 3–4 camera angles.

• Music-synced — reveals and cuts land on the beat.

• Short-form with the same feel — satisfying and dynamic, focused on the art process, the beautiful details and reveal.

This is a specialist style. If your experience is mostly talking-head, gaming, or corporate video, this role likely isn’t the right fit. Reference videos — both long-form and short-form — will be shared with shortlisted applicants.

Portfolio required — applications without a portfolio will not be reviewed

Process

Submit your application ? complete paid edit test with real footage ? begin a trial period if selected. We’re hiring one editor for the long term, not a one-off project.

To apply, reply with

1. Your portfolio — 2–4 full long-form edits that best match the work described above, plus up to 5 short-form edits (YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, or similar). Send published links we can watch in a browser, not files to download. If you were not the only editor working on a project, specify exactly which parts of the video were completed by you.

2. In 2–3 sentences: what makes a video tutorial satisfying to watch?

3. Availability: your time zone, the hours per week you can commit, and whether the turnaround above is realistic for you.

Begin your reply with the word PHTHALO so we know you read this in full.

Serious applicants only. Applications that skip the questions or the code word are not reviewed.

title: Executive Operations Analyst | CEO Support & Business Reporting
description:

We are a small, entrepreneurial company with an international presence, working with customers and partners across the United States, Europe, and beyond.



Our team values intelligence, initiative, integrity, exceptional attention to detail, and people who take genuine ownership of their work. We believe in building long-term relationships with talented professionals who want to contribute, grow, and make a meaningful difference.



The Opportunity



We are seeking an exceptionally capable Executive Operations Analyst to become a trusted right hand to our CEO and Chief Strategy Officer (CSO).



This is not a traditional Executive Assistant role, and it is not an accounting position.



It is a unique combination of high-level executive support, business operations, analytical reporting, financial administration, and problem-solving.



Your primary responsibility will be supporting our CEO (approximately 80%) and CSO (approximately 20%), helping them stay organized, informed, and focused on the highest-value activities.



You will also serve as a central point of coordination across our business, interacting with operations, sales, marketing, accounting, and other team members on behalf of our executive leadership.



You are not being hired to support every department independently. You are being hired to help our executives move important work forward, gather information, create useful reports, coordinate projects, and ensure commitments are fulfilled.



We are looking for someone who thinks, not simply someone who completes tasks.



You should be comfortable receiving an objective, asking intelligent questions, determining what information is needed, and figuring out how to deliver an accurate, useful result.



For example:



Our CSO may ask you to develop a cash-flow forecast to help evaluate upcoming business decisions. You’ll work with the appropriate people, gather the data, build the spreadsheet, and present the information clearly.

Our leadership team may need a consolidated sales report. You’ll coordinate with our sales executives, obtain the information, troubleshoot reporting issues, and develop a useful report.

We may be planning several international medical conferences. You’ll coordinate with sales and marketing, create a tracking system, monitor deadlines, and ensure nothing falls through the cracks.

Our CEO may need help managing a busy inbox, organizing priorities, scheduling appointments, or following up on important commitments.

We will explain our objectives and train you on our business and processes. However, we want someone who naturally takes initiative, thinks critically, anticipates needs, and finds solutions without requiring constant direction.



What You’ll Be Responsible For



Executive Support & Organization



Manage and organize the CEO’s
 inbox, prioritize important communications, prepare draft responses, and ensure timely follow-up.

Coordinate executive calendars, meetings, appointments, and business travel.

Arrange flights, hotels, transportation, conferences, and occasional personal appointments.

Track priorities, deadlines, commitments, and action items for the CEO and CSO.

Conduct research, prepare documents, and coordinate special projects.

Anticipate executive needs and proactively identify ways to improve organization and efficiency.

Business Operations & Project Coordination



Coordinate projects and initiatives on behalf of the CEO and CSO, working with our operations, sales, marketing, and accounting teams.

Gather information from different departments and organize it into useful reports and tracking systems.

Monitor project timelines, deliverables, and follow-up to ensure work is completed.

Develop and improve spreadsheets, workflows, tracking tools, and standard operating procedures.

Identify inefficiencies, investigate problems, and recommend practical solutions.

Analytical Reporting & Financial Administration



Build and maintain spreadsheets, management reports, cash-flow forecasts, revenue projections, and sales performance reports.

Compile and analyze financial and operational data from QuickBooks Online, HubSpot, Excel, Google Sheets, and other business systems.

Prepare commission calculations, expense reports, reconciliations, and other recurring reports.

Assist with routine financial administration, including payroll processing, invoicing, bookkeeping coordination, and financial recordkeeping.

Work with our outside accounting professionals as needed to obtain information and support accurate reporting.

Review data for accuracy, identify inconsistencies, and communicate findings clearly to leadership.

You do not need to be a CPA or professional accountant. However, strong financial literacy, excellent numerical skills, and the ability to create sophisticated, accurate spreadsheets and reports are essential.



Who We’re Looking For



We are looking for an unusually capable professional who combines analytical intelligence with exceptional organization, sound judgment, and a proactive approach to work.



The most important qualities are:



Exceptional analytical and problem-solving ability. You can take an unfamiliar challenge, understand the objective, identify the necessary information, and develop a solution.

Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills. You are highly proficient with formulas, data analysis, reporting, and building useful spreadsheets from scratch.

Strong financial fluency. You understand business financial information, can work confidently with numbers, and are comfortable preparing financial and operational reports.

Outstanding attention to detail. You naturally verify information, catch discrepancies, and take pride in delivering accurate work.

Excellent judgment and initiative. You anticipate needs, ask thoughtful questions, identify opportunities for improvement, and know when to escalate an issue.

Strong executive presence and communication. You have excellent spoken and written English and can communicate professionally with senior executives.

Independence and accountability. You manage priorities, follow through on commitments, and take ownership of results without constant supervision.

Technological adaptability. You learn new software quickly and are comfortable using modern productivity tools, including AI, to work more effectively.

Discretion and professionalism. You can be trusted with confidential business, financial, and personal information.

Preferred Experience



We welcome candidates with backgrounds in:



Executive operations or senior executive support

Business operations or business analysis

Financial or operational reporting

Project coordination or operations management

Process improvement and workflow development

Experience with QuickBooks Online, HubSpot, payroll administration, and executive inbox management is highly desirable.



A bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, Engineering, Economics, or a related field is preferred, but demonstrated capability and relevant experience are more important than a specific degree.



We are especially interested in candidates who have personally created reports, developed systems, solved operational problems, or improved business processes - not simply maintained systems created by someone else.



What the Work Environment Is Like



Although this position involves a broad range of responsibilities, it is not an expectation that you will be performing every task simultaneously.



Our current executive support professional successfully manages the established responsibilities on a part-time schedule. We are expanding the position to full-time to provide greater availability, strengthen executive support, and create capacity for additional projects and operational improvements.



You will receive training on our business, systems, and existing processes, with the opportunity to assume greater ownership as you become familiar with the company.



We are a collaborative, professional team that values thoughtful work, accuracy, direct communication, and mutual respect.



Our CEO has high standards for quality, attention to detail, and follow-through. The right candidate will appreciate those standards and take personal pride in meeting them.



We are looking for someone who wants to build a long-term career relationship with us and become an important, trusted member of our team.



Schedule & Compensation



Full-time: Approximately 40 hours per week

Schedule: Monday–Friday, approximately 9:00 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Pacific Time

Location: Remote, Philippines

Engagement: Independent contractor

Compensation: $1,800–$2,200 USD per month, based on experience and demonstrated capabilities

Growth: Compensation and responsibilities will be reviewed after an initial 90-day period, with opportunities for further growth based on performance

Screening: Finalists will complete a practical skills assessment; reference and background checks will be required before engagement



How to Apply



Please use the subject line:



SimulEYE – Think Beyond the Task



To apply, please provide:



1. Your current résumé/CV, including relevant professional experience.

2. A brief introduction (3–5 sentences) explaining why this position interests you and how your background combines analytical reporting, business operations, and executive support.

3. One specific example of a report, spreadsheet, process, or system you personally created or improved. What problem did it solve?

4. A short introductory video (60–90 seconds) so we can learn more about you and your communication style. A simple, informal recording is perfectly fine.



Please confirm your availability to work full-time during U.S. Pacific business hours.



Please apply using at least 5 Apply Points.



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a practical skills exercise and participate in an interview.



Applications that do not follow the instructions may not be considered.



We are looking for an exceptional professional who wants to do more than manage tasks. If you enjoy solving problems, building useful systems, working with numbers, and becoming a trusted partner to executive leadership, we would love to hear from you!

title: Operations Coordinator
description:
We are looking for a reliable, organized, and detail-oriented Operations Coordinator to join our team in a long-term role.



This position is ideal for someone who enjoys staying organized, communicating with customers, managing follow-ups, solving routine problems, and helping daily operations run smoothly.



We are looking for someone who takes responsibility for their work, pays attention to detail, follows through on commitments, and can become increasingly independent over time.



Position Details



- Initial schedule: 25-30 hours per week

- Initial working days: Monday–Saturday, 5 hours per day

- Future schedule: Planned transition to 40 hours per week

- Working hours: Scheduled within the 9:00 AM–6:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time window, Monday through Saturday as applicable

- Starting pay: $3.50 per hour

- Long-term opportunity

- Paid training provided

- Performance-based bonus opportunities

- Opportunity for professional growth and advancement



The role will begin with an initial 25-hour weekly schedule, with the plan to transition to full-time hours as business needs and performance allow.



Responsibilities

- Customer Service & Communication

- Respond to customer inquiries professionally and clearly.

- Handle routine customer calls, texts, and follow-ups.

- Collect and maintain accurate customer information.

- Help customers with routine questions and requests.

- Recognize when an issue needs to be escalated.



Lead Management & Follow-Up

- Respond to new leads in a timely manner.

- Follow up with leads who have not responded.

- Keep lead information organized and updated.

- Track follow-ups so opportunities are not missed.

- Maintain accurate records of lead activity.



Scheduling & Operations Support

- Assist with scheduling and booking coordination.

- Communicate scheduling information to customers.

- Help manage routine scheduling changes according to established procedures.

- Keep operational information accurate and organized.

- Follow up on outstanding scheduling matters.



Administrative & Organizational Tasks

- Perform data entry and maintain organized records.

- Manage daily administrative tasks.

- Track assigned work, deadlines, and follow-ups.

- Use Trello to manage tasks and operational workflows.

- Use Google Workspace and other company systems.

- Follow established procedures and standard operating procedures (SOPs).



Daily Accountability & Reporting

- Complete a daily checklist.

- Submit an end-of-day (EOD) report each working day.

- Report completed work, customer and lead activity, outstanding tasks, and issues requiring attention.

- Keep Trello tasks updated.

- Communicate important updates and blockers promptly.



Independent Problem-Solving

- Handle routine responsibilities independently when authorized.

- Review available instructions and SOPs before asking questions.

- Use sound judgment when prioritizing work.

- Ask for guidance or approval when a situation falls outside established procedures.



Requirements



- Good written and spoken English.

- Good communication and customer-service skills.

- Very organized and detail-oriented.

- Reliable, consistent, and responsible.

- Able to follow instructions and established procedures.

- Comfortable learning new software and systems.

- Able to manage multiple tasks and follow-ups.

- Able to work independently while recognizing when to ask for guidance.

- Professional and respectful when communicating with customers and team members.

- Previous virtual assistant, customer service, administrative, or operations experience preferred.



Training will be provided on company systems, workflows, and procedures.



Initial 30-Day Evaluation Period



The first 30 days will be an Initial 30-Day Evaluation Period focused on training, learning the company's systems, and evaluating overall performance.



During this period, we will evaluate:



- Reliability and attendance.

- Communication and professionalism.

- Quality and accuracy of work.

- Ability to follow instructions and SOPs.

- Organization and follow-through.

- Initiative and problem-solving.

- Ability to learn and work increasingly independently.



Continued engagement and future compensation reviews will depend on performance and the needs of the business. Pay & Performance-Based Growth



The starting rate is $3.50 per hour during the initial 30-day evaluation period.



Performance reviews may take place at the following milestones:



| Review Milestone | Potential Hourly Rate |

| Initial 30 days | $3.50 |

| 30-day review | $4.00 |

| 90-day review | $4.25 |

| 6-month review | $4.50 |

| 9-month review | $4.75 |

| 12-month review | $5.00 |



Important: These are potential rates associated with performance-review milestones, not guaranteed pay increases.



Reaching a milestone does not automatically qualify someone for a raise. Increases must be earned through demonstrated reliability, quality of work, communication, organization, follow-through, initiative, adherence to procedures, and the ability to handle responsibilities successfully.



Our philosophy is simple: Time makes you eligible for a review; performance earns the raise.



Performance-based bonus opportunities may also be available.



Career Growth



We want to build a long-term team and provide opportunities for people who demonstrate strong performance, reliability, and increasing responsibility.





Advancement will depend on demonstrated ability, performance, business needs, and readiness for greater responsibility.



How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. A summary of your previous virtual assistant, customer service, administrative, or operations experience.

2. The software and tools you have experience using.

3. Your current internet speed.

4. Your computer or laptop specifications.

5. The days and hours you are available to work within the 9:00 AM–6:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time window, Monday through Saturday.

6. A **60–90 second voice recording** introducing yourself and briefly describing your relevant experience.



Start your application with: "READY TO WORK"



Applications that do not follow the instructions may not be considered.



We are looking for someone interested in a stable, long-term opportunity who is ready to learn, take ownership of their responsibilities, and grow with the role.

title: Amazon Marketplace Assistant (PPC & Inventory Management)
description:
About Us:

We are a growing, high-quality direct-to-consumer food brand with a rapidly expanding catalog on Amazon. We develop innovative pantry staples and pride ourselves on data-driven operations, healthy brand margins, and great product quality.



About the Role:

We are looking for an analytical, hands-on, and proactive Amazon Marketplace Assistant to work directly alongside the founder/operator. In this full-time, long-term role, your primary responsibility will be maintaining and scaling our Amazon store operations—with a strong focus on Amazon PPC advertising management and inventory tracking/forecasting.



You will act as the right-hand operator for marketplace execution, ensuring advertising spend is efficient, inventory never runs out, and listings remain healthy and competitive.



Key Responsibilities:



1. Amazon PPC & Advertising Management:

- Manage day-to-day PPC campaigns across Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display.

- Execute keyword harvesting, bid optimizations, search term isolation, and regular negative keyword pruning.

- Monitor, evaluate, and optimize campaign performance against strict ACoS and TACoS targets.

- Identify wasted spend and scale high-converting keywords to support existing products and new launches.



2. Inventory Review & Restock Planning:

- Monitor FBA inventory levels, run-rates, and restock limits across all SKUs.

- Track days-of-supply (DOS) and flag low inventory well in advance to prevent stockouts.

- Assist in planning shipment quantities and reconciling inbound receiving discrepancies.



3. Marketplace Operations & Catalog Health:

- Monitor Seller Central account health, notifications, stranded inventory, and listing suppressions.

- Coordinate with Amazon Seller Support to resolve ticket escalations and listing errors.

- Support keyword research and backend listing updates using tools like Helium 10.

- Compile concise weekly performance reports covering ad spend, TACoS, sales volume, and inventory health.



What We Are Looking For:

- At least 1–2 years of direct, hands-on experience inside Amazon Seller Central.

- Proven track record running and optimizing Amazon PPC campaigns (must understand ACoS, TACoS, ROAS, and bid adjustments).

- Strong proficiency in Google Sheets / Excel (comfortable with formulas, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, and pivot tables).

- Familiarity with Amazon research & optimization tools (Helium 10, Jungle Scout, or similar).

- High accountability, strong critical-thinking skills, and excellent written English.

- Reliable high-speed internet connection and dedicated workstation.

- Looking for a stable, long-term, full-time commitment (40 hours/week).



How to Apply (Attention-to-Detail Test):

We value team members who are meticulous and read instructions thoroughly. To be considered, please reply with the following:



1. Change the subject line of your message to: 

   "Amazon Operator Ready – [Insert how many years of Amazon PPC experience you have]"

2. Share a brief summary (3–4 sentences) of your experience managing Amazon PPC and Seller Central. Mention the tools you use (e.g., Helium 10, spreadsheets) and your typical approach to controlling TACoS/ACoS.

3. Briefly describe how you monitor inventory run-rates to prevent stockouts.

4. Confirm your availability to work full-time (40 hours/week) long-term.



Applications that do not follow these instructions or do not use the specified subject line will be automatically archived. We look forward to reviewing your application!

title: Online Arbitrage Sourcer
description:
Full-Time Amazon Product Sourcer (VA)



- Work Schedule: 40 hours per week  

- Starting Pay: $2.50/hour during the 1–2 week trial  

- Payment Growth: Monthly raises and performance bonuses  



1. About the Job

We are looking for an experienced Amazon Online Arbitrage (OA) product sourcer to work with us full-time.



You will find profitable products for our clients. Most of our clients are new Amazon sellers, so they can only sell certain products.



This makes sourcing more difficult. We need skilled VAs who can consistently find profitable products that our clients are allowed to sell.



We provide large performance bonuses and pay skilled VAs very well.



2. Important Requirements

- You must work 40 hours per week.

- You must use Timeproof to track your working hours.

- You must work exclusively for us.

- You cannot share the products you find with other Amazon sellers.

- You must be able to consistently find profitable, ungated products.

- You must be willing to learn and follow our sourcing method.



Please do not apply if you cannot consistently find ungated products that meet our requirements.



We only hire the best VAs. If your performance is poor during the trial, you will not be hired for the long term.



3. Product Requirements

Every product you submit must meet these requirements:



- Profit: At least $3 per unit

title: Video Editor (Long Term Position)
description:
Video Editor – YouTube, Reels & Short-Form Content (Long-Term Position)



Company: Peakfinity Labs  

Website: 
  

Position: Video Editor  

Job Type: Full-Time / Long-Term  

Location: Remote



About Us



Peakfinity Labs is a supplement and cosmetic contract manufacturing company helping eCommerce entrepreneurs build, launch, and scale their own brands.



We work with Shopify brands, Amazon sellers, TikTok Shop entrepreneurs, and established businesses to develop and manufacture high-quality products.



We're building a strong presence across YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, and X by producing educational, engaging content about eCommerce, entrepreneurship, supplement manufacturing, and building successful consumer brands.



This isn't a position where you'll simply cut clips and add subtitles. We want someone who understands storytelling, pacing, viewer psychology, and how to keep an audience engaged.



What You'll Be Doing



- Editing short-form and long form videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, LinkedIn, and X.

- Editing longer educational YouTube videos, interviews, and company content.

- Turning raw talking-head footage into engaging, professionally edited videos.

- Creating attention-grabbing hooks within the first few seconds.

- Adding clean, modern captions, motion graphics, B-roll, animations, and sound effects where appropriate.

- Incorporating footage from our manufacturing facilities, laboratories, production lines, and warehouses.

- Finding relevant B-roll, screenshots, graphics, and visual examples to support what's being discussed.

- Removing unnecessary pauses, filler words, and sections that hurt pacing.

- Repurposing long-form videos into multiple short-form clips.

- Maintaining consistent branding, typography, and editing styles.

- Organizing project files and managing multiple video projects.

- Working with our team to continuously improve editing quality and audience retention.



What We're Looking For



Required Skills:



- Strong experience editing short-form social media content.

- Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or similar professional editing software.

- Ability to create motion graphics using After Effects or equivalent tools.

- Excellent understanding of pacing, storytelling, and audience retention.

- Experience editing talking-head videos, educational content, or business-related videos.

- Ability to use B-roll, visual storytelling, and graphics to make complex subjects easy to understand.

- Strong attention to detail, particularly with audio, captions, and transitions.

- Ability to follow creative direction while also contributing your own ideas.

- Good English comprehension and communication skills.

- Reliable internet connection and ability to meet deadlines consistently.



Bonus Skills:



- Experience editing YouTube videos for business or educational creators.

- Experience with direct-response advertising or eCommerce brands.

- Understanding of YouTube analytics, retention graphs, and content performance.

- Experience with AI-powered editing tools.

- Ability to create professional thumbnails.

- Experience with color grading and audio enhancement.

- Familiarity with content from business creators such as Alex Hormozi or similar educational channels.



Our Editing Style



We're looking for clean, modern, professional editing that prioritizes viewer engagement. We will provide examples.



Our content includes:



- Educational videos explaining how supplement manufacturing works.

- Behind-the-scenes footage of real manufacturing facilities.

- Business and eCommerce advice for entrepreneurs.

- Founder-led talking-head videos.

- Industry breakdowns and comparisons.

- Interviews, discussions, and longer YouTube videos.



We want videos that feel polished and credible while still being entertaining.



We do NOT want excessive transitions, unnecessary animations, or distracting effects every two seconds.



Every edit should have a purpose.



The goal is to make complicated subjects interesting, keep viewers watching, and establish Peakfinity Labs as a trusted authority in the manufacturing industry.



What Makes Someone Successful in This Role?



We're looking for an editor who thinks beyond simply completing an assigned video.



A great candidate will:



- Recognize when a section of footage is boring and know how to improve it.

- Understand how the first 3 seconds influence short-form video performance.

- Know when to use B-roll, graphics, or a simple clean cut.

- Be comfortable suggesting improvements to pacing and structure.

- Understand the difference between editing for TikTok and editing for YouTube.

- Take ownership of their work without needing constant supervision.

- Be interested in improving their skills and growing alongside our company.



What We Offer



- Long-term, consistent work with a growing company.

- Opportunity to work on a variety of interesting video projects.

- Creative freedom to contribute ideas and improve our content.

- Clear direction, organized workflows, and constructive feedback.

- Opportunities for increased responsibility as our content operation expands.

- Competitive compensation based on experience and skill level.



We're looking to build a long-term relationship with the right person, not hire someone for a handful of videos.



How to Apply



Please include the following information in your application:



1. Your portfolio: Send a link to your previous video editing work. YouTube, Google Drive, Vimeo, or a personal portfolio website are all acceptable.

2. Relevant experience: Briefly describe your experience editing short-form videos, YouTube content, or educational/business videos.

3. Software:Which editing programs do you primarily use?

4. Availability: Are you available for full-time work? How many hours per week can you commit?

5. Your strongest work: Which 2–3 existing videos in your portfolio best demonstrate your editing abilities, and why?



Important: We're particularly interested in editors who have experience making educational or talking-head content engaging. Please prioritize relevant examples in your portfolio.



We're excited to find someone who wants to grow with Peakfinity Labs and help us build a high-quality content operation.

title: Ongoing 3D Sculptor for Fantasy Hair Crowns — $25 per Design (Remote)
description:
About us



Fable & Crown creates sculptural back crowns: detailed hairpieces that curve around the back of the head, are 3D printed, and are finished by hand. Our collection draws on woodland creatures, sweeping wings, antlers, Celtic ornament, botanical forms, and gothic fantasy — wearable art for Renaissance faires, fantasy weddings, and everyday storybook magic.



See our visual direction: 



The work



This is ongoing, per-design sculpting work — not a one-off. We start with ONE paid sample design ($25). If it meets our quality bar, you get steady ongoing work at $25 per completed design, with new briefs on a regular basis.



Payment: per completed design, paid on delivery and acceptance.



Quality bar



- High-detail organic sculpting (creatures, ornament, botanical forms)

- Print-ready geometry: clean topology, watertight STL, proper wall thickness for FDM printing

- Designed to print with minimal to few supports

- Clean underside with space for comb attachment (dimensions agreed before modeling)



Beyond the briefs — the long-term play



We're looking for a creative partner, not just hands. As we build together, we want you bringing ideas to us: researching what's trending across movies, shows, and pop culture, mocking up concept renders (AI image tools are great for this), and pitching designs you'd be excited to sculpt. Every concept we greenlight becomes a paid design. The better your ideas, the more designs you get — this is how a $25/design gig grows into a real creative partnership.



Deliverables per design



- Approved, completed 3D sculpt

- Clean, watertight STL at the agreed size

- Editable native source file (ZBrush, Blender, or equivalent)

- Front, back, and side preview renders

- Multiple revision rounds within the agreed brief



Requirements



- Strong portfolio of organic/fantasy sculpting (this matters more than anything)

- ZBrush or Blender, with proven experience preparing models for 3D printing

- 2-day turnaround per design, with revisions within 24 hours

- Original work only — we require exclusive commercial ownership of final designs and source files. No resold marketplace models or unlicensed third-party assets.



To apply, answer all four:



1. Portfolio links — 3–5 examples of your sculpting, especially organic ornament, fantasy accessories, jewelry, creatures, or models you have successfully 3D printed. (Required — applications without a portfolio will not be reviewed.)

2. Software you use and your experience preparing printable models.

3. Your estimated turnaround per design.

4. Our budget is $25 per completed design, including revisions and the deliverables above — let us know if that works for you.



Shortlisted candidates will receive reference sheets showing the level of sculpted detail and finish we expect.

title: Senior Estimator – Estimator Support & Quality
description:
Location: Remote (Philippines)

Hours: Full-Time (40 hours per week)

Working Hours: Australian Business Hours

Experience: Minimum 2 years of Australian steel fabrication or engineering estimating experience



About the Opportunity



We are seeking an experienced Senior Estimator to join an established Australian steel fabrication and engineering business, providing dedicated support to the existing Senior Estimator and Project Management team.



This is a hybrid role, with approximately 70% focused on Estimator Support and 30% on Quality Support.



The primary focus will be assisting the existing Senior Estimator with the preparation of estimates, material take-offs, cutting 

lists, supplier pricing, tender documentation, and other estimating requirements.



The role will also provide quality support across projects, including preparing QA documentation, NDT requests, MDRs, weld maps, and maintaining welding and quality registers.



The ideal candidate will be an experienced steel fabrication estimator who also has practical experience in quality control, welding documentation, project coordination, or fabrication quality processes.



This is not a standalone Senior Estimator position. The successful candidate will work as a hands-on support resource, stepping in to assist with estimating and quality requirements as needed while working closely with the existing team.



Key Responsibilities



Estimator Support – Primary Focus



- Support the existing Senior Estimator with day-to-day estimating activities.

- Review client RFQs, drawings, specifications, and project documentation.

- Interpret design and engineering requirements and identify information requiring clarification.

- Prepare detailed Material Take-Offs (MTOs).

- Prepare material quantities, cutting lists, and other fabrication-related documentation.

- Determine material, machinery, labour, fabrication, and other project requirements.

- Assist with preparing detailed estimates and cost calculations.

- Obtain and compare supplier pricing for materials and fabrication requirements.

- Liaise with suppliers to obtain current and accurate material costs.

- Assist with preparing quotations, proposals, and tender submissions.

- Review estimates for accuracy, scope, quantities, and pricing before submission.

- Assist with quote revisions, variations, and changes to project requirements.

- Support the Senior Estimator with tender deadlines and estimating workload.

- Step in and provide estimating coverage when required.



Technical & Fabrication Support



- Read and interpret engineering, fabrication, structural, and mechanical drawings.

- Review job packs and identify materials and fabrication requirements.

- Understand steel fabrication processes and associated material and labour requirements.

- Assist with identifying suitable fabrication methods and requirements.

- Prepare and maintain fabrication-related documentation, including MTOs and cutting lists.

- Identify discrepancies, missing information, or potential issues within drawings and project documentation.

- Liaise with the estimating, operations, project management, and quality teams to clarify technical requirements.



Quality & Documentation Support – Approximately 30%



- Support the Quality function when required across active projects.

- Analyse job packs and prepare MTOs as required for quality and project documentation.

- Prepare Weld Maps by identifying appropriate weld procedures and marking welds on drawings and weld traceability - documentation.

- Prepare QA Packs for client submission and approval.

- Compile proposed weld procedures, welder qualifications, and supporting reports for project documentation.

- Prepare NDT requests for projects.

- Prepare Welder Qualification Requests where required.

- Follow up with suppliers for material certificates and surface treatment reports.

- Prepare Manufacturer's Data Reports (MDRs).

- Track outstanding MDRs for completed projects and ensure they are submitted on time.

- Maintain accurate records of welder qualifications and welding documentation.

- Maintain the Welder Qualification Register, including weld reports and upcoming requalification requirements.

- Maintain the Weld Procedure Register and update it when new procedures are received.

- Prepare and maintain other project quality documentation as required.

- Assist with Delivery Dockets and related project documentation.



Project & Team Support



- Work closely with the Senior Estimator, Project Managers, Operations, and Quality personnel.

- Provide estimating and quality support across multiple projects as priorities change.

- Participate in daily online communication, meetings, drawing reviews, and project discussions.

- Proactively communicate progress, outstanding information, pricing issues, quality requirements, and potential risks.

- Raise issues early and seek clarification rather than allowing problems to delay estimates or project documentation.

- Assist Project Managers with project documentation, variations, and technical information where required.

- Help ensure a smooth handover from estimating through to project delivery.

- Provide fill-in support for both estimating and quality functions when required.



Essential Requirements



- Minimum 2 years of experience in Australian steel fabrication or engineering estimating.

- Strong understanding of steel fabrication estimating, including materials, labour, machinery, and fabrication requirements.

- Demonstrated experience preparing MTOs, estimates, quotations, or tender submissions.

- Ability to read and interpret engineering, structural, mechanical, and fabrication drawings.

- Experience working with steel fabrication projects, including structural steel, piping, specialised welding, or related fabrication.

- Strong understanding of welding and fabrication processes.

- Experience with quality documentation, quality control, or project documentation.

- Ability to create or understand Weld Maps and weld traceability documentation.

- Familiarity with NDT requests, QA Packs, MDRs, welder qualifications, and welding registers.

- Understanding of traceability, tracing, and document storage requirements.

- Strong Microsoft Excel skills and experience with estimating or digital take-off software.

- Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

- Strong organisational and time-management skills.

- Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.

- Proactive approach to communication, problem-solving, and teamwork.

- Comfortable working remotely and collaborating daily with an Australian team.



Highly Desirable



- Previous experience working for an Australian steel fabrication or engineering business.

- Experience across both estimating and quality control/quality assurance functions.

- Previous experience supporting Project Managers or Operations teams.

- Experience with structural steel, piping, specialised welding, or industrial fabrication.

- Experience preparing QA Packs and MDRs for Australian projects.

- Experience with NDT coordination and welding documentation.

- Experience maintaining welder qualification and weld procedure registers.

- Understanding of Carbon Steel welding, with exposure to Stainless Steel, Duplex Steel, Wear Plate, or other specialised steels.

- Engineering Degree, Steel Trade qualification, or relevant technical qualification.

- Experience with Bluebeam, CostX, Cubit, PlanSwift, or similar estimating and take-off software.



What Success Looks Like



- The successful candidate will become a reliable second layer of support for the existing estimating and project team.



Success means:



- Providing accurate and timely estimating support.

- Keeping MTOs, cutting lists, supplier pricing, and tender documentation organised and up to date.

- Helping the Senior Estimator manage estimating workload and deadlines.

- Providing dependable quality support when required.

- Ensuring QA Packs, MDRs, NDT requests, Weld Maps, and registers are completed accurately and on time.

- Identifying issues early and communicating proactively with the team.

- Being able to move comfortably between estimating, project coordination, and quality documentation as business priorities require.



The Opportunity



- Full-time remote position based in the Philippines.

- Work Australian business hours.

- Join an established Australian steel fabrication and engineering team.

- Work directly alongside an experienced Senior Estimator and Project Managers.

- Approximately 70% Estimator Support / 30% Quality Support.

- Opportunity to develop across estimating, project coordination, and quality functions.

- Long-term opportunity within a collaborative and technically focused team.

title: NOW HIRING Senior Credit Repair Specialist | RESULTS-DRIVEN | Proven Deletions Required
description:
# NOW HIRING: ELITE CREDIT REPAIR SPECIALIST

**OPULENT CREDIT | REMOTE – PHILIPPINES**



**RESULTS-DRIVEN PROFESSIONALS ONLY | SERIOUS APPLICANTS**



Opulent Credit is a growing U.S.-based credit restoration and financial services company seeking an **elite, highly experienced, results-driven Credit Repair Specialist** to become an integral part of our expanding operation.



We are NOT hiring beginners, generic dispute processors, or individuals who simply generate letters and wait for results.



**WE NEED PROVEN SPECIALISTS WHO KNOW HOW TO EXECUTE AND DELIVER LEGITIMATE DELETIONS.**



We expect exceptional attention to detail, advanced dispute knowledge, strong organization, professional communication, and an unwavering commitment to results.



Our objective is to build a seamless, efficient, scalable credit restoration operation supported by exceptional professionals.



**If you cannot demonstrate successful dispute outcomes, independently manage client files, and execute with precision, this position is not for you.**



## PRIMARY OBJECTIVE: FAST, LEGITIMATE RESULTS



We are specifically seeking specialists with documented success obtaining **FIRST-ROUND AND SECOND-ROUND DELETIONS** where supported by reporting inaccuracies or other legitimate grounds.



Candidates must have demonstrated experience addressing:



- Charge-offs and collections

- Late payments and inaccurate payment histories

- Unauthorized or inaccurate hard inquiries

- Repossessions and derogatory accounts

- Incorrect balances, statuses, and reporting dates

- Duplicate accounts and inaccurate personal information

- Complex, multi-account credit profiles

- Straightforward profiles requiring targeted corrections



We expect candidates to know how to identify the strongest legitimate dispute grounds, prioritize actionable inaccuracies, and pursue timely deletions and corrections.



**Speed, precision, and measurable outcomes are essential.**



We do not accept unnecessary delays, unsupported disputes, generic letters, or repetitive work without a defined strategy.



We understand that bureaus and furnishers control investigation timelines and that accurate, verifiable information cannot simply be guaranteed for deletion. We expect the fastest lawful execution and strongest fact-supported strategy possible.



## REQUIRED TECHNICAL EXPERTISE



### Advanced Credit Report Analysis



You must independently analyze comprehensive three-bureau reports and identify:



- Inaccurate, incomplete, or unverifiable information

- Potential FCRA and FDCPA violations

- Relevant Metro 2 reporting discrepancies

- Incorrect payment histories and account statuses

- Improper dates, balances, and account details

- Appropriate grounds for bureau and furnisher disputes

- Opportunities for lawful reinvestigation, correction, or deletion



You must know **which legal requirement applies, why it applies, and how to use it appropriately**.



### First-Round and Second-Round Dispute Execution



Required capabilities include:



- Customized, fact-based dispute letters

- Strategic first-round and second-round dispute preparation

- Direct creditor and furnisher disputes

- Bureau reinvestigation procedures

- Method-of-verification requests where appropriate

- Debt validation requests where applicable

- Review and analysis of investigation responses

- Proper follow-up on unresolved inaccuracies

- Identification of incomplete or unreasonable investigations

- Thorough tracking of outcomes and deadlines



Every dispute must have a clear factual basis and a documented objective.



**Mass-produced, unsupported dispute letters are unacceptable.**



### FTC Reports, CFPB Complaints & Consumer Law



Candidates must understand:



- FCRA, FDCPA, FACTA, and applicable credit reporting requirements

- Relevant Metro 2 reporting standards

- FTC identity theft reporting for legitimate, qualifying identity theft cases

- CFPB complaint preparation and escalation when warranted

- Supporting documentation and evidence requirements

- Proper handling of bureau and furnisher correspondence



We expect aggressive advocacy within the law—not fabricated claims, false identity theft reports, or misuse of consumer protection processes.



## SOFTWARE & WORKFLOW REQUIREMENTS



**LetterStream experience is strongly preferred and will be central to our intended mailing workflow.**



Candidates should have experience with:



- **LetterStream:** dispute letter preparation, mailing, and tracking

- **DisputeFox:** preferred; potential credit repair management platform

- Credit Repair Cloud or comparable dispute management software

- Google Sheets and Google Drive

- Three-bureau credit report review and comparison

- Structured client tracking and case management



You must be able to work within Opulent Credit's selected systems and follow our operational procedures.



## SEAMLESS OPERATIONS, ORGANIZATION & ACCOUNTABILITY



We are building a professional operation that can grow without sacrificing service quality.



**We do not want to micromanage our specialist.**



Every client must have an organized, up-to-date case record containing:



- Initial credit analysis and documented findings

- Individual dispute strategy

- Accounts targeted and factual dispute grounds

- Letters prepared and sent

- Mailing confirmations and tracking information

- Bureau and furnisher responses

- Confirmed deletions and corrections

- Remaining unresolved items

- Follow-up deadlines

- Next-round action plans



### Mandatory Reporting



**WEEKLY REPORTS ARE REQUIRED.**



Weekly reports must include client-by-client progress, actions completed, verified results, unresolved items, upcoming deadlines, and planned next steps.



**DAILY REPORTS MUST BE AVAILABLE WHEN REQUESTED OR OPERATIONALLY NECESSARY.**



Daily reporting may include completed submissions, important correspondence, urgent issues, and time-sensitive follow-ups.



We expect proactive updates, clear communication, and accurate records.



**Management should never have to chase you for basic information about a client's file.**



## PERFORMANCE STANDARDS



Our specialist must demonstrate:



- Proven first-round and second-round dispute results

- Rapid, accurate preparation and submission of legitimate disputes

- Strong analytical and legal knowledge

- Ability to handle both complex and straightforward profiles

- Independent case management

- Consistent deadline tracking and follow-through

- Excellent organization

- Professional written communication

- Confidential handling of client information

- Ability to manage increasing client volume without sacrificing quality



Performance will be evaluated using documented case quality, submission timeliness, compliance, reporting accuracy, client progress, and confirmed dispute outcomes.



**We have a very low tolerance for careless work, missed deadlines, poor communication, inflated results, or unnecessary delays.**



## DOCUMENTED DELETION RESULTS — REQUIRED TO APPLY



**Applicants must provide verifiable, redacted examples of successful credit repair outcomes.**



We want to see:



- Before-and-after credit reports

- Confirmed collection deletions

- Charge-off deletions

- Late-payment corrections or deletions

- Inquiry removals

- First-round and second-round results

- Complex cases with documented outcomes



All sensitive personal information must be removed before submission.



Results must be attributable to work you personally performed.



**Applications without documented outcomes will not advance to the interview stage.**



Claims of experience without evidence are not sufficient.



## COMPANY GROWTH & LONG-TERM OPPORTUNITY



Opulent Credit is establishing its backend fulfillment infrastructure in preparation for a major expansion of its marketing and client acquisition efforts.



Our growth strategy includes:



- Aggressive social media marketing

- Lead generation campaigns

- Streamlined client acquisition funnels

- Automated onboarding and client management

- Increasing client volume

- Expansion of our fulfillment team



We're seeking a specialist who can grow with the company, maintain exceptional standards, and potentially advance into greater responsibilities as the operation develops.



Additional client assignments and future leadership opportunities may become available based on business growth and individual performance.



**We're building an elite operation, and everyone involved must be prepared to operate at that standard.**



Our owner is Filipino and has family in the Philippines. We value building strong professional relationships with talented specialists based in the Philippines.



## COMPENSATION STRUCTURE



**Compensation is structured per client, per completed dispute round.**



Opulent Credit will discuss compensation directly with shortlisted candidates during the interview process.



The agreed rate, defined scope of each round, completion criteria, reporting requirements, and payment terms will be established before work begins.



Additional work outside the agreed scope will be addressed separately.



**Applicants are not required to submit their desired salary or rate.**



We are seeking professionals who are confident in their ability to demonstrate results and contribute to a growing operation.



## APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS — READ CAREFULLY



**To be considered, you MUST answer all seven questions below.**



**1. EXPERIENCE:** How many years have you personally worked in credit repair, and how many active client files have you independently managed simultaneously?



**2. PROVEN RESULTS:** Provide redacted before-and-after evidence of successful charge-off, collection, late-payment, or inquiry deletions/corrections. Identify which results were achieved in the first or second round.



**3. FIRST-ROUND STRATEGY:** Explain your approach to reviewing a new client's three-bureau report, identifying legitimate inaccuracies, and preparing an effective first-round dispute strategy.



**4. LEGAL EXPERTISE:** Explain your experience applying the FCRA, FDCPA, FACTA, Metro 2 reporting requirements, and appropriately using FTC reports and CFPB complaints.



**5. SOFTWARE:** Describe your experience with LetterStream, DisputeFox, Credit Repair Cloud, and other relevant tools.



**6. ORGANIZATION & REPORTING:** Explain how you maintain client records, track dispute deadlines, document outcomes, and deliver weekly and requested daily progress reports.



**7. AVAILABILITY:** Confirm your availability to begin with a smaller client portfolio and accept additional assignments as our business grows.



**Incomplete applications, generic responses, and applications without documented results will not advance.**



Shortlisted applicants may be required to complete a practical, fictional or properly anonymized credit report analysis exercise to demonstrate dispute judgment, legal understanding, accuracy, and reporting quality.



## FINAL MESSAGE



**OPULENT CREDIT IS NOT LOOKING FOR AVERAGE.**



We're building a serious, scalable credit restoration business, and our clients deserve exceptional service.



We expect professionals who are organized, knowledgeable, accountable, aggressive in pursuing legitimate corrections, and committed to measurable results.



No fluff. No shortcuts. No unsupported promises. No careless execution.



**IF YOU HAVE THE EXPERIENCE, DOCUMENTED RESULTS, DISCIPLINE, AND PROFESSIONALISM TO OPERATE AT A HIGH LEVEL, WE WANT TO HEAR FROM YOU.**



**OPULENT CREDIT**



*Precision. Accountability. Execution. Results.*

title: Amazon Online Arbitrage Product Researcher (3+ Years Experience of Amazon Online Arbitrage) – FBM Focus
description:
About the Position



I am looking for an experienced Amazon Online Arbitrage (VA) Product Researcher with at least **3 years of proven experience** finding profitable products for Amazon sellers.



My business focuses primarily on **Amazon FBM (Fulfilled by Merchant)**. I need someone who can find products from legitimate online retailers that I can purchase and resell on Amazon for a profit.



I am looking for quality over quantity. I do not want random product leads or products that only appear profitable. Every recommendation must be thoroughly researched, supported by data, and meet my criteria before I consider purchasing it.



Main Responsibilities



- Find profitable Amazon Online Arbitrage opportunities from legitimate online retailers.

- Use SellerAmp SAS, Keepa, and Amazon Seller Central to research and evaluate products.

- Analyze historical Buy Box ownership, pricing, and seller competition.

- Focus on products where FBM sellers receive most of the Buy Box opportunities.

- Identify listings where the Buy Box rotates among multiple FBM sellers over time.

- Prioritize listings with limited FBA competition.

- Analyze sales rank, historical demand, estimated sales velocity, and price stability.

- Calculate all applicable costs, net profit, ROI, and profit margin.

- Verify that the source product exactly matches the Amazon listing, including brand, model, size, quantity, and variation.

- Check selling eligibility in my Amazon Seller Central account whenever possible before recommending a product.

- Identify potential risks, including price drops, Amazon competing on the listing, restrictions, authenticity concerns, and intellectual property issues.

- Provide accurate research and supporting evidence for every recommended product.



### Required Product Criteria



**1. FBM Seller Competition**



- Target approximately 0–15 competing FBM sellers.

- Prefer listings with little to no FBA seller competition, ideally 0–2 FBA sellers.

- Evaluate the current number of active FBM and FBA offers.

- Do not automatically reject listings with zero FBM sellers, but verify that demand and the available opportunity justify entering the listing.



2. Buy Box Rotation — Highest Priority**



This is one of the most important requirements for this position.



I want products where the Buy Box is **primarily held by FBM sellers and rotates among multiple FBM sellers over time**.



- Use Keepa and other available research tools to examine historical Buy Box ownership and pricing.

- Look for evidence that multiple FBM sellers have received Buy Box opportunities.

- Determine whether the Buy Box rotates regularly or whether one seller consistently dominates it.

- Prioritize listings with a realistic opportunity for a new FBM seller to compete.

- Avoid listings where FBA sellers or Amazon dominate the Buy Box, unless there is strong evidence that an FBM offer can still compete successfully.

- Include evidence of the rotation in your research.

- If rotation cannot be verified, clearly mark it as unverified rather than claiming it meets the requirement.



Do not assume that a low seller count automatically makes a product a good opportunity. Historical data, demand, pricing, and competition must support the recommendation.



**3. Profitability Requirements**



- Minimum estimated net profit: **$3 per unit after all applicable costs**.

- Minimum target ROI: **30%**.

- Higher profit and ROI are preferred.

- Include purchase price, applicable taxes, inbound shipping, Amazon fees, customer shipping costs, and other relevant expenses.

- Use realistic selling prices based on historical data, not temporary price spikes.

- Do not recommend products that fall below the minimum requirements unless clearly identified for separate approval.



**4. Demand and Price Stability**



- Confirm reasonable sales demand using Keepa and available sales-rank data.

- Review historical Buy Box prices and sales-rank trends.

- Avoid products with weak demand, frequent price crashes, declining selling prices, or excessive competition.

- Estimate monthly sales only when reliable data is available.

- Consider whether the expected profit is likely to remain available long enough to sell the inventory.



**5. Selling Eligibility and Product Verification**



- Check whether I am eligible to sell each product in my Amazon Seller Central account before recommending a purchase whenever possible.

- Clearly distinguish verified eligibility from unverified eligibility.

- Confirm that the retailer's product is an exact match for the Amazon listing.

- Avoid questionable sourcing and products with significant authenticity, brand, or intellectual property risks.

- Never claim a product is eligible unless it has actually been checked.



Required Experience and Tools



Applicants must have at least 3 years of hands-on Amazon Online Arbitrage product research experience.



You must be comfortable using:



- SellerAmp SAS

- Keepa

- Amazon Seller Central

- Amazon fee and profitability calculators

- Online retail websites for sourcing



You must understand FBM versus FBA competition, Buy Box eligibility and rotation, historical pricing, and how to evaluate whether a product is genuinely worth purchasing.



Quality Standards



- Quality is more important than quantity.

- Follow my requirements consistently.

- Do not submit random products just to meet a daily quota.

- Do not inflate estimated profits or rely on unrealistic selling prices.

- Provide supporting evidence for your conclusions.

- Be honest when information cannot be verified.

- Research products carefully before recommending that I spend money on them.



### Application Questions



Please answer these questions when applying:



1. How many years of Amazon Online Arbitrage research experience do you have?

2. Have you researched products specifically for Amazon FBM sellers? Explain your experience.

3. Do you have experience with both SellerAmp SAS and Keepa?

4. How do you determine whether the Buy Box primarily belongs to FBM sellers and rotates among multiple FBM sellers?

5. How do you evaluate FBA versus FBM competition?

6. What minimum ROI and net profit do you typically target?

7. How do you verify selling eligibility in Amazon Seller Central?

8. Can you provide an example of a product you have researched, including your reasoning? Remove any confidential client information.



I am looking for a reliable, detail-oriented researcher interested in a long-term working relationship.



### Required Google Sheets Product Research Tracker



At the bottom of your workflow, you must maintain a **Google Sheets spreadsheet** containing every product you recommend.



The spreadsheet must be organized, accurate, and shared with me with editing access. Each product must have its own row, with the following information documented:



**Product Information**



- Date researched

- Product name and brand

- ASIN

- Amazon product link

- Retailer name and direct source link

- Product size, model, variation, and quantity



**Costs and Profitability**



- Purchase price

- Applicable sales tax

- Inbound shipping costs

- Expected Amazon selling price

- Amazon referral fees

- Estimated FBM shipping costs

- Other applicable expenses

- Estimated net profit per unit

- ROI percentage

- Profit margin percentage

- Recommended purchase quantity

- Estimated total investment and total profit



**Competition and Buy Box**



- Current FBM seller count

- Current FBA seller count

- Current Buy Box price

- Whether the Buy Box is primarily held by FBM sellers

- Whether the Buy Box rotates among multiple FBM sellers

- Keepa link and evidence of historical rotation

- Whether one seller consistently dominates the Buy Box

- Whether Amazon competes on the listing



**Demand and Pricing**



- Current sales rank

- Historical sales-rank trends

- Estimated monthly sales, when reliable

- Historical Buy Box pricing

- Price stability

- Recent price drops and demand concerns



**Eligibility and Risks**



- Seller Central eligibility status

- Whether eligibility was actually verified

- Confirmation of an exact product match

- Potential restrictions, sourcing, authenticity, or intellectual property concerns

- Additional risks and researcher notes



**Final Recommendation**



- Decision: Buy, Review Further, or Reject

- Brief explanation of why the product meets or fails my criteria

- Any information that still needs verification



Include clickable product links and relevant Keepa data wherever possible. Keep all research in this central spreadsheet rather than sending scattered product lists.



I will review the spreadsheet before d
 which products to purchase. **Do not mark a product as a qualified recommendation unless it meets my criteria or any exceptions are clearly identified for my approval.**
